descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world’s leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we’ve grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.

Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain’s mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.


As Director of Product, you will be responsible for driving the vision, strategy, and execution of our product portfolio to deliver exceptional Core Platform & CRM products & services whilst achieving our business goals. You would develop and lead a world class team of product leaders across our locations and be responsible for your platform pillar experience within the Entain group for all our markets and all our brands.

In your role you are part of the Senior Product Leadership Team and will also be working with Entain’s Global Leadership, reporting to the CTO you will be part of the Platform Team.

Are you ready to launch a winning career?


What will you do:

  • You will develop and articulate a compelling and inspiring Core Platform and CRM product vision and strategy that delights our upstream services and customers. You will live and breathe the data and insights about your products, constantly seeking points of leverage that will help us achieve Entain’s broader goals and ambitions.
  • You will champion our transformation of the Platform by partnering with the Platform Engineering Director to modernise the Core Platform and CRM (reward) components which underpin all our businesses.
  • You will design a model for the core Player Account Management (PAM) services as a Platform-as-a-Service, enabling flexible integration and loose coupling.
  • You will use a techno-functional approach to design backend systems that support multiple micro frontend labels effectively.
  • You will develop, lead and coach a stellar team of product managers, guiding them in discovery, prioritization, and execution of product initiatives. By providing development, coaching, objectives and goal setting and performance management, you will ensure the team is motivated and productive, achieving real customer and business impact.
  • You will ensure that your product organisation is aligned with the broader company in pursuing the best opportunities, collaborating closely with cross-functional leaders including design, technology, compliance, commercial, finance and legal.
  • You will partner with technology and design teams to deliver a world class product offering, ensure quality, effective and timely product delivery. You will drive product metrics that demonstrate your product impact for our customers and our business. Aligning product direction and roadmap, you will be making trade-offs as necessary with key stakeholders across the business to deliver high-quality products at a predictable cadence.
  • You will serve as product evangelist both internally and externally. Present product updates and benefits to stakeholders, customers and partners


Qualifications:

  • Significant Product leadership experience managing and leading at a director level in a Product-Led organisation.
  • A demonstrated track record of successfully launching and iteratively scaling online products.
  • Strong understanding of the ecommerce landscape, including knowledge of regulations and compliance considerations when building great customer experiences.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing empowered product teams.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, and customer and business problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, capable of collaborating with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Results-driven mindset with a focus on achieving business objectives while maintaining a player-centric approach.
  • Demonstrable evidence of influencing at senior levels of an organisation, the ability to get stakeholders and teams to buy-in into your product vision


Leadership responsibilities:

  • Set the vision and direction for the team, which aligns to our overall business strategy.
  • Provides effective and inspiring leadership and guidance to the teams, ensuring that they are working effectively and efficiently to achieve company goals.
  • Recruits, develops, and retains top talent, actively coaching people to develop and grow, creating development opportunities as they arise.
  • Build a high-performance team culture where outstanding performance is recognised, rewarded and celebrated.


Company Benefits

We know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire peak performance. Join us, and a competitive salary is just the beginning.

Depending on your role and location, you can expect to receive benefits like:

  • Safe home pickup and home drop (Hyderabad Office Only)
  • Group Mediclaim policy
  • Group Critical Illness policy
  • Communication & Relocation allowance
  • Annual Health check

And outside of this, you’ll have the chance to turn recognition from leaders and colleagues into amazing prizes. Join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.

Position Title - Head - Application & Product Development

Years of Experience - 18 to 22

Location - Vilayat, Bharuch, Gujarat


Job Purpose

Establish a fully developed Research & Development Centre targeting to Applied research for Chlor-Alkali products to bring in improvement /value addition to existing Products /Processes and develop a range of products, applications and product variants to suit requirements for Industrial/ water treatment/ Plastic and allied sector aligned to business objective.

Build strong technical competence in resolving customer problems, testing, analysis for Chlor-Alkali products with support for required certification of products.


Key Result Areas


1 - Establishment Research center & execution of research: Identification and execution of long term projects & goals for R&D Centre

  • Identify new segments and markets that require new products and work in collaboration with marketing to develop new products and applications
  • Establishment of Plasticizer Centre
  • Chart out the mandate for the Application Development Center
  • Prepare and pursue Annual P&B for R & D Centre and seek necessary budget approvals
  • Preparation of monthly MIS dashboards and deck presentation in reviews. (Meeting with BH, SBU Head & CMO)
  • Selection of skilled technical resources at R&D Centre

2 - New Product & Application development: Develop applications/ new product development and formulations

  • Understand and analyze the existing market trends, in-house competencies and propose development.
  • Ensure field testing of products to map them to the range of applications.
  • Work closely with Supply chain in optimizing and standardizing raw materials and testing procedures

3 - Recognition, accreditation, collaboration & certification: Identify and collaborate with various bodies for recognitions, accreditations as well collaborate with institutes for research projects and product Certification

  • Coordinate with Government agencies to complete the requisites and file necessary applications.
  • Identify and collaborate with recognized institutes/ organization to collaborate on the research projects.
  • Identification of required certification and ensuring requirement for existing ceritficates for all the products for DCA
  • Supporting the Units for annual audits and ensuring closure of NCs

4 - Product Improvement: Ensure product consistency and improvement by pilot trials.

Monitor, audit and control all testing procedures and set benchmark for product standards.

  • Extend support to the manufacturing team for improvement in existing products and processes.
  • Set up pilot tests, quality plans, procedures, documentations and report
  • Assist marketing in developing product data sheets, brochures, and other supporting documents

5 - Process Improvement: Ensure process reliability by pilot trials.

Monitor, audit and control all testing procedures and set benchmark for process standards.

  • Extend support to the manufacturing team for improvement in existing processes.
  • Set up pilot tests, quality plans, procedures, documentations and report

6 - People development & management: Managing and motivating team and ensure team has relevant skill set and abilities to perform.

  • Have clear goals & review mechanism for all the team members.
  • Formulate training plans for the Team.
  • Provide regular guidance, motivation & clear directions to team members.

7 - Technical support to customers & sales team: Responsible for building expertise and capabilities and support customers and internal team on technical front.

  • Build knowledge pool at Center by evaluating raw material, products and applications.
  • Regular trainings on NPD/ Application/ trends for internal team and dealers / customers
  • Closely work with customers to identify issues and accordingly work out solutions
  • Organize pilot and plant scale trails at customer site
  • Management of customer complaints, Improvement and communication to management

8 - Communication & IPR

  • Attend seminars and exhibitions to make presentations research findings.
  • Ensure publication and patenting of research findings

9 - Safety & policies: Ensuring Safety practices and implementation of policies

  • Ensuring safety practices in the laboratory at all levels including metrological conditions
  • Ensure implementation of all the HR processes and policies

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Product Management based in India.

This is a senior product leadership role focused on shaping and scaling a next-generation communications platform powering enterprise contact center experiences. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for a core product ecosystem spanning APIs, UI capabilities, developer tools, and AI-enabled components that enable customers and partners to build scalable, intelligent engagement solutions. The role sits at the intersection of platform innovation, developer experience, and enterprise SaaS transformation. You will lead and mentor a team of experienced Product Managers while driving alignment across Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Go-To-Market functions. With a strong focus on AI-native evolution, you will help transform a leading contact center product into a modular, decomposed platform of services. This role also carries significant leadership responsibility within the India hub, influencing culture, execution, and ways of working across a large distributed organization. It is an opportunity to have both deep product impact and broad organizational influence in a global, fast-scaling environment.

Accountabilities

  • Define and lead the product vision, roadmap, and execution strategy for platform services, APIs, and developer infrastructure powering a large-scale contact center ecosystem
  • Drive the evolution of the product into modular, AI-native, and decomposable platform components aligned with long-term architecture strategy
  • Own end-to-end product delivery, ensuring strong alignment between roadmap priorities, engineering execution, and business outcomes
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Champion world-class developer and customer experiences through improvements in APIs, SDKs, documentation, and tooling
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver scalable and resilient platform capabilities
  • Act as a key leadership figure within the India site, contributing to organizational culture, talent development, and cross-team alignment

Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 4+ years in a leadership role managing platform or infrastructure product teams
  • Proven experience building and scaling platform products such as APIs, developer tools, or cloud-native SaaS infrastructure
  • Strong technical depth with the ability to engage in architectural discussions and evaluate trade-offs in distributed systems
  • Experience working on multi-tenant SaaS platforms at scale
  • Background in Contact Center (CCaaS) or Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) domains preferred
  • Demonstrated success in hiring, leading, and mentoring high-performing Product Management teams
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across global, cross-functional teams
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, Voice AI, or agentic frameworks is a strong advantage
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant field

Benefits

  • Competitive executive-level compensation package aligned with experience
  • Performance-based incentives and long-term growth opportunities
  • Fully remote flexibility within India with global team collaboration
  • Comprehensive healthcare, wellness, and parental support programs
  • Generous paid time off and additional wellbeing leave policies
  • Opportunity to shape a flagship global platform product at scale
  • High-impact leadership role with visibility across global engineering and product teams
  • Strong learning culture with exposure to cutting-edge AI and platform technologies.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Job Description

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.

As a Vice President of Product Management in wholesale lending services team, you will lead the strategy and delivery of digital solutions that transform our wholesale lending business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve product vision, multi-year strategy, and roadmap, aligning to business priorities, regulatory/controls requirements, and customer outcomes.
  • Lead people management: hire, coach, develop, and performance-manage product talent; set operating cadence, standards, and career growth plans.
  • Establish and run program governance (operating model, decision forums, intake/prioritization, dependency management, risk/issue management, and execution reporting).
  • Provide data insights for leadership: define KPI frameworks/OKRs, build executive-level dashboards, translate metrics into narrative, and drive decisions with evidence.
  • Direct solution discovery with cross-functional partners (engineering, design, data, operations, controls) to identify scalable solutions and validate value.
  • Lead product planning and delivery across portfolios/releases—ensuring scope clarity, sequencing, and timely launches with measurable benefits.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and controls to define target-state workflows, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer value.
  • Apply Agile-at-scale practices to improve throughput and predictability; remove impediments and manage trade-offs across competing priorities.
  • Drive change management and end-user adoption: stakeholder mapping, comms/training plans, enablement materials, feedback loops, and adoption measurement.
  • Ensure quality and readiness through test management and automation, production verification, and post-release monitoring; drive continuous improvement via root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering to ensure secure, resilient delivery and alignment to architecture, data, and platform standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, IT, or related field
  • Demonstrated leadership as a VP/Senior Product Manager/Product Lead delivering digital transformation in financial services (wholesale lending).
  • Strong understanding of wholesale lending processes, digital technologies, and risk/controls considerations in regulated environments.
  • Proven people leadership experience (managing PM/PO teams), including coaching, operating cadence, and talent development.
  • Strong change management capability to drive adoption and measure behavior change/outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, organization, and presentation skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and Agile tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence or equivalent).

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Expertise across the product lifecycle: discovery → delivery → launch → adoption → optimization.
  • Strong data literacy: KPI/OKR design, dashboarding, insight generation, and executive storytelling to influence decisions.
  • Experience leading program governance and cross-functional execution across multiple workstreams and dependencies.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

descriptionHtml:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Bogie Product Director in Bangalore we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your strategic vision and leadership expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates.

You'll play a pivotal role in driving innovation, ensuring the development and delivery of high-performing, cost-effective, and competitive bogie products that align with Alstom's mission for smarter and greener mobility. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, industrial, procurement, tender and costing), lead product roadmaps, and ensure the successful execution of programs, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of coordinating product strategies and roadmaps, as well as ensuring product readiness for tenders and projects, but also fostering collaboration across teams to achieve quality, cost, and delivery targets.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Representing the RSC Platform on-site and ensuring innovation, development, tendering, launch, and sustainability for assigned technologies and products
  • Overseeing product portfolio management and ensuring alignment with the RS platform
  • Leading product roadmap activities, including development, procurement, and industrial strategy
  • Delivering QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) targets for programs
  • Managing product validation and homologation processes to meet market regulations
  • Driving product competitiveness through continuous improvement and Return of Experience (REX)

All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Master’s degree in a technical or equivalent field
  • 10+ years of experience in product management
  • Knowledge of product business and industrial environments
  • Experience in transversal and/or international leadership roles
  • Fluency in both English and French
  • Strategic vision and ability to benchmark competition
  • Strong management and organizational skills within a matrix environment
  • Excellent communication skills and team-oriented mindset
  • Proactive problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Knowledge of the railway industry

Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
  • Work with new security standards for rail signalling
  • Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
  • Contribute to innovative projects
  • Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment
  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
  • Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
  • Progress towards senior leadership opportunities
  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

About GMNS Product Team

As part of the Global Merchant & Network Services group (GMNS), the GMNS Product team is at the core of American Express, uniquely positioned to support every business unit and customer across the Enterprise. The American Express Network enables over $1.6 trillion in annual spend, serving our Issuers and Acquirers in more than 170 markets worldwide.

We are driving a strategic, multi-year Enterprise Payments program to bring all payments together into a centre of excellence to drive operational excellence for payment execution, enable innovative payment products, services, and capabilities to be built effectively and efficiently, support our BU strategies more closely, and deliver on our customers’ evolving payment needs.

About The Role

The Director Enterprise Payments Product Development is an exciting role, responsible for building modern, scalable enterprise payment capabilities and ensuring high quality predictable delivery across global markets. This role sits within the Enterprise Payments Centre of Excellence and partners closely with Product Management Architecture Engineering Operations and Market teams to translate product strategy into robust technical capabilities and platform solutions.

This leader will be accountable for shaping how Enterprise Payments capabilities are designed, built, and delivered, while driving modernization of legacy payment flows and scaling bank based money movement solutions globally and transforming how payment platforms are developed at American Express.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a high performing product development organization responsible for delivering enterprise grade payment capabilities across Bill Payments, Money Movement, Multi-Rail initiatives
  • Translate enterprise and product management strategies into clear capability roadmaps, technical delivery plans and executable backlogs aligned to priorities
  • Lead discovery and technical solutioning for new payment flows, bank integrations and money movement capabilities supporting critical customer and business journeys
  • Own Product delivery outcomes for Enterprise Payments products including quality reliability scalability and time to market across global releases
  • Define and refine capabilities features user stories and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions meet functional regulatory operational and market needs
  • Balance global platform standardization with market specific requirements ensuring scalable solutions while meeting regulatory and local banking needs
  • Drive modernization of payment capabilities including migration from legacy solutions to resilient scalable and cloud enabled platforms where applicable
  • Establish and monitor delivery and performance metrics to improve predictability throughput quality and incremental value delivery
  • Champion modern product development and delivery practices including agile ways of working iterative value delivery and strong collaboration across teams

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of leadership experience leading Product Development, Product Management, Platform Engineering or a similar role.
  • Deep interest in payments and financial technology with experience or exposure to Bill Pay, A2A payments, ACH, RTP, wires or bank integrations strongly preferred
  • Proven experience building and leading high performing teams across multiple locations and working effectively in a global enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise platforms or shared services that support multiple business units and markets
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity make trade-offs and drive execution at scale
  • Ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders across Product Management Technology Operations and Business teams
  • Experience driving modernization initiatives and adopting new ways of working including scaled agile delivery models
  • Bachelor’s or Masters’ Degree in Engineering, Product, Business or related field.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Competitive base salaries
  • Bonus incentives
  • Support for financial-well-being and retirement
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
  • Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
  • Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
  • Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
  • Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
  • Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

descriptionHtml:
Head of Product | B2B Fintech | Series A Bengaluru · Full-time

one of the fastest-growing B2B fintech platforms in an emerging market — profitable since day one, growing 6–9x year-on-year, and backed by some of the most respected names in global venture and operator investing. We are looking for a Head of Product to own our core expense management product and work directly alongside our Co-Founder & CPO.

The role

This is not a coordination role. You will own the expense management product end-to-end — what gets built, why, and in what order — and be accountable for outcomes. You will work in close partnership with our Co-Founder (engineering and product background, McKinsey Digital, deeply technical) and the Bengaluru engineering team.

What you will own:

  • Full product ownership of our core spend management product — corporate cards, spend controls, real-time visibility, and the workflows our customers rely on daily
  • The AI automation layer — receipt matching, reconciliation, document extraction, and defining what the next generation of finance automation looks like in production
  • Roadmap prioritisation grounded in deep customer understanding across 2,000+ business customers
  • Close day-to-day partnership with engineering — making tradeoffs with full technical context, not handing over specs

What we are looking for

  • 10-12+ years in product, with meaningful B2B experience — fintech, payments, or enterprise SaaS preferred
  • Technical credibility — comfortable going deep with engineers on architecture and systems decisions
  • AI-native product thinking — you treat AI as infrastructure, not a feature, and know how to embed it into workflows users rely on without noticing
  • Startup orientation — you apply rigour where it matters and move fast everywhere else
  • Someone who wants to build alongside a founder with strong opinions and will push back with equally strong ones

  • Translate enterprise and product management strategies into clear capability roadmaps, technical delivery plans and executable backlogs aligned to priorities
  • Lead discovery and technical solutioning for new payment flows, bank integrations and money movement capabilities supporting critical customer and business journeys
  • Own Product delivery outcomes for Enterprise Payments products including quality reliability scalability and time to market across global releases
  • Define and refine capabilities features user stories and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions meet functional regulatory operational and market needs
  • Balance global platform standardization with market specific requirements ensuring scalable solutions while meeting regulatory and local banking needs
  • Drive modernization of payment capabilities including migration from legacy solutions to resilient scalable and cloud enabled platforms where applicable
  • Establish and monitor delivery and performance metrics to improve predictability throughput quality and incremental value delivery
  • Champion modern product development and delivery practices including agile ways of working iterative value delivery and strong collaboration across teams

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of leadership experience leading Product Development, Product Management, Platform Engineering or a similar role.
  • Deep interest in payments and financial technology with experience or exposure to Bill Pay, A2A payments, ACH, RTP, wires or bank integrations strongly preferred
  • Proven experience building and leading high performing teams across multiple locations and working effectively in a global enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise platforms or shared services that support multiple business units and markets
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity make trade-offs and drive execution at scale
  • Ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders across Product Management Technology Operations and Business teams
  • Experience driving modernization initiatives and adopting new ways of working including scaled agile delivery models
  • Bachelor’s or Masters’ Degree in Engineering, Product, Business or related field.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Competitive base salaries
  • Bonus incentives
  • Support for financial-well-being and retirement
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
  • Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
  • Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
  • Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
  • Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
  • Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

descriptionHtml:
We're partnering with a premium consumer and hospitality company that has built a family of much-loved brands across dining, retail, and experiences. Over the last decade they have earned something rare: people came for the food, and stayed for the feeling.


As the business enters its next phase, they are looking for a senior leader to build the layer that deepens that relationship. Someone who can bring together customer data, CRM, loyalty, community, and AI, not as a set of systems, but as a way to make guests feel known, looked after, and genuinely closer to the brand.

This role reports directly to the founders. The operational foundation, the systems that run the business day to day, is already in place, held by a strong internal team. Your job is to build the growth and experience layer on top of it: the part that turns affection into a lasting, connected relationship across every brand.


What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the company's guest data, CRM, loyalty, and engagement strategy, with a view of loyalty that is about trust and belonging, not just points
  • Build a single, connected view of the guest across brands, channels, and touchpoints, without ever making the experience feel cold or transactional
  • Partner with marketing, CX, content, and business teams to deepen customer journeys, retention, and community
  • Use AI, automation, and technology thoughtfully, where it genuinely improves marketing, retention, service, and decision-making, never for its own sake
  •  Evaluate and bring in the right tools, platforms, and partnerships to support long-term growth, building on the foundation already in place
  • Sit with the founders on the bigger questions: what loyalty and community really mean for a hospitality brand, and how technology can amplify hospitality rather than replace it


What We're Looking For

  • 6 to 12 years across Product, CRM, Customer Experience, Loyalty, Growth, Martech, or Customer Data
  • A track record of building engagement, retention, loyalty, or personalisation initiatives at real scale
  • Strong grasp of CRM ecosystems, customer data, and lifecycle marketing, and the ability to turn data into relationships, not just campaigns
  • Comfortable combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and working through an existing team rather than around it
  • Experience in consumer-facing businesses: retail, hospitality, food, D2C, lifestyle, or technology platforms
  • Hands-on experience with AI-driven customer experience or growth is a plus, not a requirement
  •  Most of all: you think of customers as guests, not data points, and you care about how a brand makes people feel. That instinct matters here more than any single tool on your CV.


Why Consider This Role?

  •  A direct partnership with the founders, on something they care about deeply
  • The chance to define a brand-new capability, on top of a foundation that is already built, so you are creating, not firefighting
  • Real influence over guest experience, loyalty, community, and growth across multiple brands
  •  A rare brief: use technology to make a beloved hospitality company more connected and more loved, without losing the warmth that built it


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn or write to work@allthingstalent.in

descriptionHtml:
Role: PM Head – Clients Business

Location – Bangalore


Key Responsibilities:

P&L & Strategic Management:

· Category Ownership - Own the sales targets and full P&L responsibility for the Windows, Chromebook, and Thin Client business units.

· Strategy Execution - Define and execute product strategies to increase market share and profitability across diverse client computing hardware.

· Market Analysis - Monitor trends in the PC market, competitive moves from OEMs (HP, Dell, Lenovo), and evolving customer needs to refine business strategies.


Sales Enablement & GTM

· Joint Planning – Create GTM plans with sales leadership for market coverage and optimized offering mixes.

· Enablement - Develop initiatives to support regional sales teams, focusing on the unique value propositions of Windows and ChromeOS ecosystems.

· KPI Management - Define success metrics and KPIs for the product team to ensure data-driven decision-making.


Desired Profile

· Leadership Experience - Proven background in product management or business leadership, specifically within End-User Computing or Enterprise IT Infrastructure.

· Industry Expertise - Strong understanding of the Windows and ChromeOS landscape, including hardware life cycles and thin client deployments.

· Soft Skills - Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to lead change in a fast-paced environment.

· Analytical Rigor - Strong strategic thinking abilities and the capacity to manage multiple stakeholders while driving double-digit business growth


OEM Relationship Management

The PM Head is responsible for managing a multi-OEM portfolio, requiring a balanced approach to ensure Ample remains a preferred partner across competing brands.

· Strategic Alliance Development - Build and maintain high-level relationships with regional and national leads at Dell, HP, and Lenovo to secure "Preferred Partner" status and top-tier rebates.

· Ecosystem Integration - Manage the tripartite relationship between Hardware OEMs (e.g., HP), OS providers (Microsoft/Google), and Chipset manufacturers (Intel/AMD) to drive "Whole-Product" solutions.

· Joint Business Planning : Lead QBRs with OEMs to align on volume commitments, specialized pricing, and MDF.

· Conflict Resolution: Act as the primary escalation point for deal registration conflicts or supply chain bottlenecks across the various client lines.


Leadership & Stakeholder Mapping

The PM Head acts as the central node connecting internal execution with external partner goals.

· Internal Mapping – Mapping various stakeholders such as Sales Leadership on Market coverage, GTM. RPM on Monitoring and driving regional execution of strategy, growth & OEM engagement. Logistics & Finance – Ensuring we deliver on time and plan the inventory| Review category profitability & Rebate attainment.

· OEM, Distributor & Partner Leadership Mapping.

· Team Mentorship - Lead and manage a team of Regional Product Managers, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making and result-oriented performance.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexmoney

Flexmoney’s mission is to “Re-imagine Consumer Credit” for the mobile-first digital

consumer. Our omni-channel embedded finance affordability platform enables merchants,

brands and partners to seamlessly embed contextual affordability options across all customer

touchpoints and sales channels, so as to drive higher conversion and increase customer

satisfaction and loyalty. We work with trusted lending partners (Banks, NBFCs, FinTechs) to

develop and offer RBI-compliant, digital credit products embedded in consumer journeys.


Flexmoney was instrumental in working with Banks and merchants to create and establish

the “Cardless EMI” product category in the market, enabling lenders to offer a fully digital

transacting EMI instrument to their users at checkout without the need for a credit card.


We power Cardless affordability for 68,000+ online merchants (including marquee

merchants such as Flipkart, Amazon and MakeMyTrip) across categories such as travel,

insurance, home, fashion, sports, electronics, mobiles, health and wellness.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Product Head to own and drive the product vision, strategy, and

execution for Flexmoney’s affordability platform. This is a high-ownership role for someone

who has built and scaled enterprise / B2B products from early traction to meaningful scale —

ideally through the 1→10 and 10→100 phases. You will lead a team of 6–7 product managers

and work at the intersection of merchants, lenders, and consumers to build the infrastructure

that makes EMI-based purchases seamless across India’s merchant network.


This is not a “maintain and optimize” role – while v1 of our suite is in-market, we foresee a

rich roadmap ahead as commerce increasingly splits into new channels such as social,

influencer-led and agentic. We are looking for someone who can think from first principles,

make hard trade-offs, and build products that merchants/brands and partners genuinely want

to adopt and scale with. In addition, the successful candidate will have a commercial mindset

and work with our Sales, Partner and Business teams to collaboratively identify and ship new

features to drive additional value for our customers and new revenue opportunities for

Flexmoney.


Key Responsibilities:

• You will own the end-to-end product roadmap for Flexmoney’s omni-channel digital

affordability suite — spanning merchant-facing omni-channel commerce journeys

(consumer onboarding, personalized financing offers surfacing, checkout experiences,

merchant dashboard) lender integrations, and consumer EMI experiences.

• In addition, you and your team will define the core digital credit platform roadmap

allowing multi-lender seamless financing as a service in every customer journey

• Define and drive product strategy aligned with business goals, working closely with

the CEO, engineering, business, and lending partnerships teams.

• Lead, mentor, and scale a product team of 5–7 PMs — setting the bar for rigour in

problem definition, prioritisation, and execution.

• Be the voice of the customer. Deeply understand merchant and partner needs, pain

points, and workflows to build products that drive adoption, activation, and retention.

• Drive platform scalability — you’ve been through the messy middle of scaling a product

from early-stage traction to a platform serving thousands of businesses, and you know

what breaks and what holds.

• Own key product metrics: merchant activation rates, EMI transaction conversion,

disbursal throughput, lender partner NPS, and platform reliability.

• Work with engineering to make smart technical trade-offs, manage technical debt,

and ship with velocity without compromising quality.

• Build and institutionalise product processes — discovery, spec writing, sprint planning,

launch readiness, and post-launch reviews — appropriate for Flexmoney’s stage.


Qualifications:

Must-Have:

• 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3–4 years in Ecommerce /

commerce enablement / Enterprise / B2B / B2B2C product roles.

• Demonstrated experience scaling products through the 1→10 and 10→100 growth

phases — not just 0→1 ideation.

• Strong merchant-facing or partner-facing product experience — you’ve built products

where the buyer is a business (not a consumer), and you understand enterprise sales

cycles, integration complexity, and partner success.

• Experience managing and growing a product team of 6+ people, including hiring,

coaching, and performance management.

• Ability to operate at both the strategic (quarterly roadmap, market positioning) and

tactical (user stories, edge cases, release management) levels.

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable with data, metrics, and making decisions with

imperfect information.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with C-

suite, engineering leadership, and external partners.


Strong Bonus:

• Prior experience in lending, fintech, payments, or consumer credit / EMI infrastructure.

• Familiarity with India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, BBPS, Account Aggregator) and how it

shapes product design in financial services.

• Experience with platform / marketplace dynamics — multi-sided products where you’re

serving merchants, lenders, and consumers simultaneously.

• Background in checkout, payment gateway, EMI, or point-of-sale product ecosystems.


Why Flexmoney?

• You’ll have an opportunity to work closely with the Founder/CEO of the Company and

real influence on Company direction.

• Flexmoney sits at the intersection of affordability, payments, and commerce —

powering how India’s merchants make purchases accessible through EMI.

• Small, high-calibre team (~60 people) with deep domain expertise in banking,

consumer internet, and infrastructure — zero bureaucracy.

• The product-market fit is proven with 73M+ credit-verified users and 68,000+

merchants. The opportunity now is to scale — which is exactly the kind of problem this

role is designed to solve.

About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly entrepreneurial and technically strong Head of Product & Commercialisation to lead an AI-enabled B2B SaaS platform in the ESG, Sustainability, and LegalTech space. The product is already live, funded, and solving emerging challenges across large digital platforms.

This is a founder-facing leadership role with end-to-end ownership of product strategy, technical product direction, commercialization, partnerships, and go-to-market execution. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping product vision, driving adoption, and preparing the business for scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive product strategy, roadmap, positioning, packaging, and commercialization.
  • Lead product innovation through customer discovery, market research, and feature ideation.
  • Define and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies and product launches.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to define technical requirements, APIs, integrations, workflows, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and execution plans.
  • Build relationships with ecosystem partners, agencies, and strategic stakeholders.
  • Leverage customer feedback, market insights, and product data to drive decision-making.
  • Support business growth, market expansion, and long-term scaling initiatives.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS or Enterprise Software environments.
  • Proven experience building, launching, or scaling SaaS platforms or technology products.
  • Strong Technical Product Management experience, including APIs, integrations, workflows, platform products, and data-driven solutions.
  • Experience owning product strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, and product lifecycle management.
  • Experience with product launches, GTM strategy, commercialization, and market adoption.
  • Mandatory ESG and Sustainability domain experience.
  • Proven experience working with ESG reporting, Sustainability platforms, ESG ratings, Governance frameworks, Compliance solutions, or related ESG-focused products.
  • Strong customer discovery, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work directly with founders and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced, and ambiguous environments.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or intelligent workflow platforms.
  • Experience with LegalTech, RegTech, ComplianceTech, Governance, Risk, or regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or merchant-facing products.
  • Background in product marketing, pricing strategy, partnerships, or international product launches.


Why Consider This Opportunity

  • Founder-level ownership and influence.
  • Product already live and funded — not an idea-stage startup.
  • Opportunity to build and scale an AI-powered ESG & Sustainability SaaS platform.
  • Small, focused team with significant growth potential.
  • Direct impact on product direction, commercialization, and company growth.

YMinds.AI is a specialist talent partner helping startups and high-growth companies hire exceptional talent across Product, Engineering, AI, Data, and Digital functions.

descriptionHtml:
About The Company

Wadhwani AI Global (WAIG) is a non-profit AI research and product organisation building AI for social impact across the Global South, outside India. We work with governments, multilateral institutions, foundations, and on-the-ground partners to deploy AI solutions in agriculture, health, and education at population scale. With deepening operations in Rwanda, Kenya, Ethiopia, and across the African continent, we are entering a new phase of growth — building product capability that matches the scale and ambition of our partnerships.

Requirements

Role Overview

The Head of Product will lead products across the organisation. This is a senior leadership role responsible for the AI products WAIG builds, deploys, and scales across health, education, agriculture, and other social impact verticals. This role owns the product function end-to-end and partners closely with leadership on strategy, delivery, and donor engagement.

Your Role

  • Product Strategy & Vision
  • Define the product vision, roadmap, and priorities across health, education, and agriculture verticals
  • Translate WAIG's mission and donor commitments into a coherent multi-year product strategy
  • Make build-vs-partner-vs-consume decisions for AI capabilities across the portfolio
  • Drive product positioning in donor conversations, government engagements, and partner discussions
  • Delivery & Execution
  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI products from concept through deployment and scale
  • Set and enforce product standards: discovery rigour, technical specs, evaluation criteria, deployment quality
  • Run a disciplined product lifecycle: hypothesis → MVP → field evaluation → iteration → scale
  • Ensure timely, high-quality delivery against grant commitments and donor milestones
  • Team Leadership
  • Build and lead the product organisation — recruit, mentor, and grow product talent across geographies
  • Foster a strong product culture: user-obsessed, evidence-driven, technically rigorous
  • Partner closely with the Technology team on engineering capacity, infrastructure, and ML delivery
  • External Engagement
  • Represent WAIG's product capability in conversations with governments (Ministry of ICT Rwanda, Smart Africa, ministries of health and education across Africa), multilateral institutions (UNICEF, UNDP, World Bank), and donors (Gates Foundation, others)
  • Lead product portions of major proposals and donor pitches; contribute to fundraising in partnership with the Growth lead
  • Build relationships with peer organisations, research labs, and AI-for-good ecosystems
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with senior leadership on overall organisational strategy and delivery commitments
  • Work with the Growth and Fundraising lead on pipeline shaping and proposal development
  • Support the broader leadership team in operationalising the WAIG strategy

What We Are Looking For

Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in AI product management
  • Track record of building and shipping AI/ML products at scale — in real-world deployment
  • contexts, not pure consumer or pure research
  • Direct experience working with governments on technology deployments
  • Experience working with or in Africa, the Global South, or comparable contexts strongly preferred

Capability

  • Strong technical depth — able to engage credibly with ML engineers, evaluate technical trade-offs, and shape solution architecture
  • Outstanding strategic and structured thinking — able to set priorities, kill the wrong projects, and drive focus
  • Excellent communicator — equally comfortable in a Minister's office, a donor pitch, a field site, and a code review
  • Strong people leader — has built and grown product teams in distributed, multi-geography settings

Disposition

  • Mission-aligned — genuinely motivated by AI for social impact, not just by the title or the geography
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, frequent travel, and the realities of working in emerging-market deployment contexts
  • High ownership; low ego; bias to action

About Swiggy Instamart

Swiggy Instamart, is building the convenience grocery segment in India. We offer more than 40000 items to our customers within 10-15 mins. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by making grocery delivery instant and delightful. Instamart has been operating in 120+ cities across India and plan to expand to a few more soon. We have seen immense love from the customers till now and are excited to redefine how India shops

Job Description: Sr. Manager – New Product Development (NPD) & Quality

Role: Senior Manager - Subject Matter Expert for Munchies & Snacks, Traditional Foods, Sweets, Chocolates-Confectionary, Breakfast cereals & Emerging Categories

Role Objective

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Manager – Product Development & Quality to lead end-to-end development and quality assurance across Snacking, Traditional Foods, Sweets, Breakfast Cereals, and Emerging Categories within our private label portfolio.

As the Sr. Manager – NPD & Quality, This role will serve as the technical backbone for product range expansion, transforming traditional flavors into scalable, high-quality offerings. This role bridges culinary expertise with food science, ensuring every product meets our highest standards of quality, safety, and consistency. Drive trend-led innovation while upholding world-class product quality and robust food safety standards across all categories.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Innovation

End-to-End Development: Lead the formulation of a diverse portfolio including Namkeen, Extruded Snacks, Energy Bars, and Confectionary.

Traditional Modernization: Adapt Indian Sweets, Chikki, and Traditional Foods for modern retail without losing authentic "homemade" soul.

Clean Label Initiative: Work to reduce artificial additives, moving toward natural preservatives in Chutneys and Spreads.

Health & Wellness: Drive innovation in Emerging Categories like high-protein Energy Bars, Clean-Label Spreads, and Whole-Grain Breakfast Cereals.

Develop and optimize recipes/formulations aligned to target cost, quality, and shelf-life

Drive innovation based on market trends, competitor benchmarking, and consumer insights

Conduct trials (lab & plant scale) and ensure successful commercialization

  • Quality Assurance & Standardization

Define product specifications, SOPs, and quality benchmarks for all SKUs

Establish sensory, physical, and microbiological quality parameters

Conduct supplier audits, product evaluations, and ensure batch-to-batch consistency

Implement quality improvement initiatives and root cause analysis for deviations

  • Supplier Management & Capability Building

Identify, Audit, onboard, and develop suppliers/vendors

Work closely with manufacturers to ensure adherence to product specs and process controls

Drive vendor performance through audits, scorecards, and continuous improvement plans

  • Regulatory & Compliance

Ensure compliance with FSSAI and other applicable food safety standards

Validate label claims, nutritional information, and ingredient declarations

Support regulatory documentation and approvals for new product launches

  • Cost Optimization & Productivity

Drive value engineering initiatives without compromising quality

Optimize formulations, ingredients, and processes to meet cost targets

Support scale-up efficiency and wastage reduction initiatives

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Operations for seamless launches

Align with packaging and logistics teams for shelf-life and stability considerations

Support customer feedback analysis and continuous product improvement.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic Product Development: Ability to build and drive NPD pipeline across categories, translating consumer insights and traditional recipes into scalable, commercially viable products.

Food Science & Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of ingredients, processing technologies, shelf-life, and formulation across snacks, sweets, and cereals.

Quality & Food Safety Leadership: Deep knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP/GHP with the ability to establish robust quality systems and ensure compliance across vendors.

Scale-up & Commercialization: Proven capability in moving products from lab to plant scale, ensuring consistency, efficiency, and speed-to-market.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management: Strong experience in vendor development, audits, and cross-functional collaboration (Procurement, Ops, Marketing, Supply Chain).

Cost Optimization & Value Engineering: Ability to balance cost, quality, and performance through formulation and process optimization.

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Strong root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement mindset.

Innovation & Market Orientation: Ability to identify trends, benchmark competition, and drive differentiated product offerings.

Leadership & Team Management: Capability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions and partners.

Execution Excellence: High ownership with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Travel requirement

This role requires extensive travel (~20–30%) across multiple cities and supplier locations.

Travel will be primarily for product development trials, plant validations, supplier onboarding, audits, and quality alignment.

The candidate should be comfortable working closely with manufacturing partners on-site to drive faster commercialization and consistent quality execution.

Qualifications & Experience

B.Tech / M.Tech in Food Technology/ Food Science with 10 years in R&D/NPD and Quality Assurance within the FMCG or Food Retail sector.

Experience In FMCG, QSR, Or Private Label Business Preferred

Ability to balance "the best recipe" with "the best COGS" (Cost of Goods Sold).

descriptionHtml:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

About the Role:

This isn’t a typical Head of Product role. The expectation is not just to optimize flows, but to fundamentally redefine how trading works for millions of users. You’ll step in at a critical inflection point, owning the next phase of growth for a platform already operating at scale. This role is about expanding into new product frontiers, unlocking new opportunities, and building category-defining trading experiences. It’s a high-impact mandate to drive innovation and shape the future of trading at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead a Product Management team focused on conceiving, building, and launching user-focused, high-quality products that connect and grow the crypto economy.
  • Work closely with fellow engineering, design, and business leadership to define our product vision and strategy across your product areas, and deliver tangible business outcomes.
  • Identifying and defining KPIs and metrics for the team to set targets and drive overall team performance.
  • Hire, manage, and grow a team of Product Managers and help them to reach their potential.
  • Execute efficiently in a fast-paced, fluid start-up environment where change is constant and creativity is a must.
  • Driving a cross-functional team with engineering, design, support, and marketing to resolve end to end customer issues.

You’ll Excel in This Role If You:

  • Trading experience in the past, with a strong understanding of financial markets—especially Indian markets—and a genuine passion to build and scale products in this space
  • 14+ years of Product Management experience with 4+ years in scaling digital B2C products with customer first focus
  • A deep understanding and appreciation for good design and user experience
  • A track record of building exceptional products that delight your users and produce clear business impact
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects affecting many functions, including product, engineering, finance, compliance, and support.
  • Ability to direct major cross-functional initiatives with effective prioritization and influence
  • Experience collecting both internal and external customer feedback and requests, empathizing with their challenges and opportunities, and prioritizing roadmaps to optimize results
  • Experience in A/B testing and in working with data analytics/data science teams to get metric driven analysis
  • Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
  • Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission
  • Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
  • Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

Good to have :

  • Experience working in regulated industries collaborating with legal, compliance, and customer support teams
  • Experience in software development or a sound understanding of technical architecture

Hiring Process:

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

  • Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
  • Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
  • Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
  • Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
  • Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
  • Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work:

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bengaluru office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

Perks That Empower You:

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

  • Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
  • Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
  • Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
  • Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

Ready to Build What’s Next?

If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

descriptionHtml:
About Amenify

Amenify is the leading AI-powered resident commerce platform in the US that helps property managers and residents with services they love. Through a proprietary network of local providers, enterprise integrations, and personalized concierge tools, Amenify powers services like local retail, dining, grocery, home services, maintenance, and more. Through its API integrations powering resident engagement, Amenify is available in 15 million homes in the USA. Amenify was founded in 2017 in San Francisco and has raised $25M to date. 


We encourage high-performers from all backgrounds to reach out, provided they share our core values listed here: https://www.amenify.com/about-us


About the Role

Amenify is seeking a strategic, execution-focused Director – Operations / Product to lead and scale our night-shift operations while partnering closely with leadership on product strategy, process automation, and operational excellence.

This role is ideal for a hands-on leader who can bridge day-to-day operational execution with long-term product thinking. You will be responsible for improving service quality, customer experience, provider performance, response times, and operational efficiency while translating frontline insights into product improvements.

You will work closely with customer support, operations, product, engineering, and leadership teams to identify bottlenecks, build scalable workflows, improve internal tools, and ensure the night operations team consistently delivers high-quality service.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and scale night-shift operations teams across multiple functions.
  • Ensure strong execution against key operational KPIs, including service quality, response time, fulfillment rate, issue resolution, customer satisfaction, provider performance, and SLA adherence.
  • Build scalable operational processes, workflows, playbooks, and escalation systems.
  • Drive continuous improvements in customer experience, provider experience, service reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and performance metrics to track operational health and team productivity.
  • Lead workforce planning, capacity management, scheduling, and resource allocation for night operations.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and partner with cross-functional teams to implement practical, scalable solutions.
  • Create processes that improve accountability, reduce manual work, and increase consistency across teams.
  • Ensure night-shift operations run with urgency, discipline, and strong ownership.
  • Partner with customer, operations, product, and engineering teams to define product priorities and roadmap inputs.
  • Convert operational pain points, customer feedback, provider feedback, and team insights into clear product requirements.
  • Own requirements gathering, user stories, workflow documentation, testing, and product rollout initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of internal tools, automation, and product features that improve operational speed and accuracy.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows, reduce errors, and improve team productivity.
  • Measure product success using operational and business metrics such as response time, resolution time, completion rate, customer satisfaction, provider satisfaction, and cost efficiency.
  • Act as the voice of operations in product discussions, ensuring tools are built for real-world execution and scalability.
  • Partner with leadership to prioritize product improvements that directly impact customer experience and operational efficiency.
  • Build, mentor, and develop high-performing night operations teams.
  • Manage team leads, managers, and individual contributors across multiple operational functions.
  • Create a culture of ownership, accountability, speed, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Set clear goals, performance expectations, and operating rhythms for the team.
  • Drive coaching, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
  • Improve communication, escalation handling, and cross-functional collaboration across night-shift teams.
  • Foster a team environment where people are proactive, solutions-oriented, and focused on customer outcomes.


Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience across operations, product management, business operations, customer operations, or service delivery.
  • Proven experience leading and scaling large teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Strong experience managing night-shift, support, marketplace, logistics, home services, customer operations, or service operations teams is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of operational metrics, process optimization, workforce planning, quality management, and service delivery.
  • Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to improve tools, automate workflows, and launch operational product improvements.
  • Ability to translate customer, provider, and operational feedback into structured product requirements.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building dashboards, tracking KPIs, and using data to drive decisions.
  • Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Experience building scalable operational processes, workflows, playbooks, and reporting systems from the ground up.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own critical business outcomes and drive measurable improvements.
  • Comfortable operating in a startup environment with speed, ambiguity, changing priorities, and high accountability.
  • Willing and able to work night-shift hours.


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong operational leadership with a product-first mindset.
  • Ability to execute with urgency while thinking strategically.
  • Deep ownership, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Data-driven decision-making and comfort with operational metrics.
  • Strong bias toward process improvement, automation, and scalable systems.
  • Customer-obsessed approach to service quality and issue resolution.
  • Ability to lead teams through ambiguity, change, and rapid growth.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, customer support, and leadership.
  • Passion for building high-performing teams, better tools, and scalable operating systems.


Why Join Us?

  • Above-industry salary, performance bonus, and monthly bonus opportunities.
  • Long-term stock option opportunities based on performance.
  • High-growth trajectory with rapid learning and career expansion.
  • Significant ownership of operations, product workflows, team performance, and business outcomes.
  • Direct 1:1 time with founders.
  • Team lunches, outings, and a collaborative work culture.
  • Competitive referral bonus program.
  • Opportunity to work with an ambitious, transparent, and fast-moving team.
  • Ability to directly shape the future of Amenify’s operations and product experience.


Meet Our Founders

  • Danish Chopra
  • Everett Lynn

descriptionHtml:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

The Chief of Staff, Product is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of RZR's product organization. You will work as a direct partner to the VP of Product — not as a scheduler or note-taker, but as an operator and force multiplier who translates roadmap direction into clear plans, owned milestones, and measurable outcomes.

You will work across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, and Finance, removing execution friction, improving decision quality, and ensuring the organisation stays focused on its highest-leverage product work. You'll own the product operating cadence end-to-end, build executive materials for board and leadership reviews, run deep-dive analyses when needed, and step in directly to drive critical initiatives from problem definition through delivery.

The ideal candidate is a sharp operator and analytical thinker who is genuinely comfortable in ambiguity, can hold their own in any cross-functional room, and cares deeply about outcomes — not activity or optics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end execution of high-priority product and cross-functional initiatives, from problem definition through delivery and follow-through
  • Translate roadmap direction and product strategy into clear plans, milestones, ownership structures, and success metrics
  • Partner with leaders across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Finance, and People to manage dependencies and ensure timely delivery
  • Own the product operating cadence: roadmap reviews, quarterly and sprint planning, OKR tracking, and executive product reviews
  • Build structured analyses, decision memos, and business cases to support product leadership in high-stakes decisions
  • Run product and usage deep dives directly when needed to unblock decisions or accelerate outcomes
  • Prepare leadership materials for product reviews, board discussions, and strategic planning cycles
  • Track progress against product priorities and ensure decisions are documented, communicated, and executed across the organisation
  • Step in flexibly to cover execution gaps on critical product initiatives as business needs evolve

Required Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
  • 5+ years in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Strategy, Business Operations, Consulting, Program Management, or Product Management — ideally in or adjacent to a product organisation
  • Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Strong analytical skills: structuring ambiguous problems, interpreting product and usage data, and translating insight into action
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with experience creating executive-ready materials for senior leadership and boards
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority across senior cross-functional partners
  • High ownership and bias to action; comfort managing multiple competing priorities with limited direction
  • Nice to have: experience in technology, ad tech, or product-led businesses; familiarity with product analytics, roadmapping, or OKR frameworks; MBA or advanced degree

Why Join RZR?

  • Direct seat at the table on product strategy — you'll partner daily with VP-level product leadership on the decisions that shape RZR's roadmap and future
  • Unmatched cross-functional exposure across Engineering, Design, GTM, Finance, and executive leadership, including board-level visibility from day one
  • A genuine force-multiplier role with real, organisation-wide ownership — your work will be visible at every level, not buried in a support function
  • High-trust, high-autonomy environment where outcomes matter more than titles or process — no bureaucracy, no busywork
  • Scaling a profitable, post-turnaround ad tech company into its next phase of operational and product maturity — you'll help define how the org runs
  • Clear growth path into product management, product operations, or general management for the right person

RZR Behaviors

RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership

  • Move Fast
  • Drive for Excellence
  • Proactive Communication
  • Courage
  • Curiosity
  • Deliver Results
  • Manage Ambiguity

Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 110.000 employees.Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.Our values guide how we work:We Care for our patients, each other, and our communitiesWe Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence togetherWe Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovationIn-Center as one of three therapy verticals focuses on delivering high-quality, clinic-based hemodialysis to patients worldwide.
