At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 110.000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our values guide how we work:


  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation


In-Center as one of three therapy verticals focuses on delivering high-quality, clinic-based hemodialysis to patients worldwide. Its mission is to support healthcare providers in offering safe, consistent, and patient-centered care in dialysis clinics.

The team collaborates across Product Design, Clinical Protocols, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial functions to equip clinics with effective, innovative solutions that meet high standards and improve patient outcomes. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

The Director, Product Management & Upstream Marketing is responsible for defining and driving the global portfolio strategy and lifecycle management, with a strong focus on profitability, competitiveness, and sustainability. The role leads the entry and value‑segment strategy and ensures portfolio alignment with overall business objectives, particularly in highly price‑sensitive and tender‑driven markets. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

Your Responsibilities:


  • Define and drive the global portfolio strategy, including lifecycle management, optimization, and rationalization
  • Lead the entry and value‑segment strategy to ensure strong competitiveness in price‑sensitive markets
  • Manage portfolio trade‑offs to balance growth, profitability, and complexity
  • Identify and drive initiatives to improve cost, margin, and portfolio efficiency
  • Align closely with value streams and senior leadership on portfolio priorities and decisions
  • Partner with regional and country teams on pricing, tenders, and market‑specific portfolio strategies
  • Develop a deep understanding of competitive dynamics and define response strategies against low‑cost competitors
  • Support countries in the preparation and execution of requests for proposals (RFPs)
  • Provide structured product and portfolio training in collaboration with HQ functions
  • Build strong working relationships with global sales, marketing, and cross‑functional teams
  • Engage senior leadership with clear updates on portfolio performance, risks, and strategic initiatives
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal SOPs


Your Profile:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Life Sciences, or equivalent; MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Strategy, or General Management
  • 15+ years of experience in product management within the medical device or healthcare industry
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated experience managing global portfolios across the full product lifecycle
  • Proven leadership and collaboration skills across cross‑functional and global teams, including the ability to lead and influence within complex matrix organizations without direct authority, with a self‑motivated, results‑oriented approach and comfort operating in dynamic and changing environments
  • Deep market and therapy‑area knowledge, ideally in dialysis or renal care
  • Strong expertise in upstream marketing, portfolio strategy, and lifecycle management
  • Medical‑technical knowledge of hemodialysis products and therapies
  • Experience or familiarity with digital marketing, marketing automation, and project management tools


Our Offer for you:

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.


  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world

  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Head of AI Full Stack Engineering for a global enterprise software company. This is a hands-on technology leadership role for an exceptional engineer who can architect, build, and scale modern AI-native applications while leading engineering excellence across the organization.

Unlike traditional architecture or management positions, this role requires active involvement in software development, system design, AI implementation, and engineering execution. You will work across the entire technology stack—from frontend experiences and backend services to cloud infrastructure, data platforms, AI systems, and autonomous agent frameworks. You will help shape the future of AI-powered software engineering by combining deep technical expertise with strong leadership and execution capabilities.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise-grade AI-powered products and platforms.
  • Architect and build scalable full-stack applications using modern frontend, backend, cloud, and AI technologies.
  • Drive the adoption of AI-native software development practices across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement LLM-powered applications, AI workflows, agentic systems, copilots, and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Define technical standards, architecture principles, coding guidelines, and engineering best practices.
  • Participate directly in software development, code reviews, architecture reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.
  • Build and optimize distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Establish high standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, security, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tools, translating them into practical business and engineering outcomes.
  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads while fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Partner closely with product, design, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Drive engineering productivity through intelligent automation, AI-assisted development, and modern developer experience initiatives.
Qualifications
  • 12–20+ years of software engineering experience with significant experience in full-stack architecture and technical leadership.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling complex enterprise software products.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, React, modern web architectures, APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Strong experience designing and developing cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Practical experience building AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, AI agents, MCP, orchestration frameworks, or related technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture patterns, system design, scalability, security, and performance engineering.
  • Experience leading engineering teams while remaining actively involved in coding and technical delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy applications and build next-generation platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, automated testing, and platform engineering.
  • Excellent communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Passion for leveraging AI to fundamentally improve how software is designed, developed, tested, and delivered.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building agentic AI platforms, autonomous workflows, AI copilots, or developer productivity solutions.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI tool orchestration, and agent frameworks.
  • Background in enterprise SaaS, platform engineering, or large-scale B2B software products.
  • Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Open-source contributions, technical thought leadership, or AI product development experience.
Important Notice

This is a highly hands-on engineering leadership role. We are looking for immediate joiners or candidates who can join within a maximum of 2 weeks. Please apply only if you meet this availability requirement. Candidates with longer notice periods will not be considered.

About GMNS Product Team

As part of the Global Merchant & Network Services group (GMNS), the GMNS Product team is at the core of American Express, uniquely positioned to support every business unit and customer across the Enterprise. The American Express Network enables over $1.6 trillion in annual spend, serving our Issuers and Acquirers in more than 170 markets worldwide.

We are driving a strategic, multi-year Enterprise Payments program to bring all payments together into a centre of excellence to drive operational excellence for payment execution, enable innovative payment products, services, and capabilities to be built effectively and efficiently, support our BU strategies more closely, and deliver on our customers’ evolving payment needs.

About The Role

The Director Enterprise Payments Product Development is an exciting role, responsible for building modern, scalable enterprise payment capabilities and ensuring high quality predictable delivery across global markets. This role sits within the Enterprise Payments Centre of Excellence and partners closely with Product Management Architecture Engineering Operations and Market teams to translate product strategy into robust technical capabilities and platform solutions.

This leader will be accountable for shaping how Enterprise Payments capabilities are designed, built, and delivered, while driving modernization of legacy payment flows and scaling bank based money movement solutions globally and transforming how payment platforms are developed at American Express.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Owner – Capstock POD to join our Fund & Investor Services (FIS) Platform team. This role is located in India – Pune.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Own end-to-end product strategy and delivery for Transfer Agency and Capstock flows into accounting, aligned to platform priorities and client outcomes.
  • Lead the migration of legacy processing onto ATOMx, with clear transition plans and execution against defined milestones.
  • Drive standardized and scalable processing that improves straight-through processing, reduces manual intervention, and lowers operational risk.
  • Define and prioritize the roadmap across Transfer Agency and Capstock workflows, including event processing, positions, and accounting integration.
  • Partner with Operations, Technology, and Data teams to align delivery to target operating models, control requirements, and platform strategy.
  • Act as the key coordination point across dependent PODs and platforms to manage upstream and downstream dependencies and ensure adoption of strategic flows.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries between Product, Operations, and Technology to drive execution discipline and avoid duplication.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Extensive experience in asset servicing or post-trade environments, with strong exposure to Transfer Agency, Capstock, or accounting flows.
  • Proven experience operating at Director or Senior Vice President level as a Product Owner, Product Lead, or equivalent in a complex, regulated organization.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end trade and event lifecycle processing and accounting integration.
  • Experience delivering platform migration or transformation programs, including movement from legacy to strategic architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to set clear direction, manage dependencies, and drive delivery across multiple teams.
  • Experience leading senior product or change professionals, with accountability for delivery outcomes.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

  • America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
  • World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
  • “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a strategic and technically grounded product leader to serve as Director of Platform Product Management – Infrastructure. This role will define and execute the product strategy for core infrastructure capabilities that power enterprise platforms and applications. The infrastructure platform serves both internal and external customers, enabling scalable, secure, and resilient systems.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for infrastructure platform capabilities including compute, storage, networking, cloud services, and infrastructure automation.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, architecture, operations, and security teams to deliver solutions that meet performance, availability, scalability, and compliance requirements.
  • Drive initiatives that improve infrastructure availability, performance, cost efficiency, and defect reduction, with clear KPIs and continuous monitoring.
  • Champion observability and monitoring practices to ensure visibility into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Advocate for secure-by-design principles and ensure infrastructure services meet enterprise security and governance standards.
  • Partner with internal product and application teams to ensure infrastructure services are reliable, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Prioritize infrastructure investments based on business impact, risk, and technical feasibility.
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to inform strategy.


What We’re Seeking

  • 15+ years of industry experience in technology, with at least 10 years in product management roles.
  • Proven success in managing infrastructure platform products at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and networking.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible), observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Datadog), and security frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence without direct authority.
  • Experience in financial services or other regulated industries highly desired.
  • Deep experience with compliance standards, data center operations, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field. MBA or equivalent business education.


Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

  • Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
  • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
  • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers

We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

As a Digital Product Leader at Azentio, you will drive the end-to-end digital vision and strategy across our Banking and Financial Services product portfolio. This role goes beyond individual solutions—you will lead the development of scalable, platform-first digital ecosystems, enabling seamless and customer-centric experiences across web and mobile.

You will combine strategic leadership, platform thinking, and deep BFSI domain expertise to build future-ready digital products that are modular, extensible, and aligned with evolving market needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the digital product vision and roadmap across BFS products, ensuring alignment with overall business strategy and market opportunities
  • Lead the development of platform-driven digital products, including customer portals, mobile apps, and enterprise-grade digital ecosystems across B2C, B2B2C, and broker channels
  • Drive a platform-first approach, ensuring reusable components, APIs, and scalable architecture across products
  • Own product lifecycle management—from ideation to launch and continuous enhancement
  • Prioritize and manage product backlogs, balancing customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility
  • Partner with UX/UI, engineering, marketing, and sales teams to deliver intuitive, seamless customer journeys
  • Embed Agile practices to deliver high-quality outcomes with speed and predictability
  • Manage senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to drive alignment and adoption of the digital strategy
  • Leverage data, analytics, and customer insights to continuously optimize product performance and user experience

Required Experience & Skills

  • 15+ years of experience in product management, with strong exposure to digital platforms in Banking, Financial Services, or Insurance (BFSI)
  • Strong experience in a platform-first/product platform development approach, including:
  • Designing and building scalable, modular platforms
  • Driving API-first / microservices-based architecture
  • Enabling reuse, extensibility, and ecosystem integration
  • Proven experience in building and scaling enterprise digital platforms (web & mobile)
  • Demonstrated ability to define platform strategy, including underlying architecture, integrations, and product ecosystem design

descriptionHtml:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing U.S.-based consumer lending fintech company redefining how consumers access credit and manage their financial lives. Our mission is to simplify and democratize financial access through smart, data-driven digital solutions.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Vice President of Product to lead our India-based product organization. This leader will manage a team of 10–15 high-performing Product Managers and play a critical role in defining and delivering our global product vision. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product strategist, skilled communicator, and inspiring leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, business, and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

• Drive the end-to-end product strategy, vision, and execution for our consumer lending and digital financial products.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10–15 Product Managers to create a high-performance product culture.

• Partner closely with global executives, engineering, design, and analytics to deliver best-in class fintech experiences across full customer life cycle (including but not limited to application stage, delinquency management, and returning customer strategy).

• Translate the company's strategic goals into clear product roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

• Oversee product lifecycle management—from concept to launch, iteration, and scale.

• Leverage data and user insights to drive decisions that enhance product performance and customer satisfaction.

• Stay current with fintech trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to ensure product innovation.

• Collaborate with U.S. stakeholders to ensure strong communication and alignment across global teams.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree from a reputed institution (MBA or equivalent preferred).

• 10+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 5 years leading product teams. US experience will be a plus.

• Proven track record of building and scaling digital products in fintech, digital lending, or e commerce ecosystems.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities with a data-driven decision-making approach.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills across global teams.

• Hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work in fast-paced, evolving environments.

• Deep understanding of technologies in fintech systems, APIs, cloud platforms, and user experience design.


Why Join Us

• Opportunity to influence a global product vision from India.

• Work with world-class technology and leadership teams.

• High-impact role in a mission-driven fintech shaping the future of digital lending.

• Competitive compensation, benefits, and flexibility in a remote-first environment.

descriptionHtml:
The Product Management Senior Manager is a senior management level position responsible for managing a broad range of Product Management employees, setting strategy and providing direction, leadership and budgetary management, etc. Additionally, this role will be responsible for the development of product plans, strategies, and tactics while coordinating product lines through product life-cycles in coordination with the broader Product Management team. The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of professional to accomplish established goals and conduct personnel duties for team (e.g. performance evaluations, hiring and disciplinary actions)
  • Manage strategic program roadmap, program/product launch, and program marketing to gain maximum benefit from each product
  • Monitor client and competitor market research to ensure successful execution of a marketing plan spanning product, brand, acquisition, customer and retention, and improving performance, brand preference, and client engagement
  • Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, group of countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units
  • Manage day-to-day product marketing for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
  • Participate in development of client valued propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
  • Oversee program life cycle including market demands, technology trends, and the competitive field as well as develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace
  • Define and launch new products, features, and capabilities including defining the product/feature and go-to-market strategy, and participate in technology development and market launch activities
  • Engage with external partners and/or vendor relationships, engage in negotiations, manage ongoing relationships, and prepare agreements
  • Deploy profitable marketing strategies, lead conceptualization and implementation of key growth initiatives, and maintain current market intelligence on the overall industry verticals and competitors
  • Assist in building new relationships in supported verticals using available tools such as industry publications, direct mail, internet presence, trade shows, calls, and strategic alliances
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

Qualifications:

  • 10 plus years of relevant experience
  • Previous supervisory experience across multi-function and/or global business
  • Experience with banking and investment products
  • Working knowledge of the different systems, theories, and practices relevant to a function as well as practical experience of multiple business cycles
  • In-depth knowledge of industry and competitor products/services
  • Working knowledge of industry practices and standards
  • Working knowledge of strategic direction of the function within the business as well as a solid conceptual/practical grounding in function and/or area of expertise
  • Ability to develop strategy, resources, and inspire a diverse set of individuals
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated negotiation skills

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. With 1500+ customers in 60+ countries, strong product-market fit, and world-class investor support, we’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is building AI that transforms how the world's most sophisticated professionals work. We are looking for a Group Product Manager based in Bengaluru to drive the strategy, development, and delivery of Harvey's Knowledge Platform — the systems that connect Harvey to the legal world's content and tools. This means owning how we build and scale our ecosystem of third-party connectors and data partner integrations that bring rich legal context into Harvey, strengthening core user engagement. This is Harvey's first PM hire in India and a foundational role: you will own a critical product area end-to-end, work closely with our India Engineering team and cross-functional partners across time zones, and shape how Harvey builds and ships products. You will collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, Business Development, Legal Engineering, and GTM teams.

What You'll Do

  • Develop the product roadmap for Harvey's integrations and Knowledge Platform, defining vision, strategy, and priorities across document management systems, the legal tech connector ecosystem, and private legal data.
  • Partner closely with Harvey's India Engineering team to scope, design, and ship high-quality integrations and platform experiences at a rapid pace
  • Drive the strategy for expanding Harvey's connector ecosystem: integration aggregators and self-serve pathways that allow customers and partners to connect their own tools to Harvey at scale.
  • Work closely with business development to engage with partners and manage complex joint developments
  • Deeply understand the workflows of lawyers at leading law firms and in-house legal teams, translating that understanding into product decisions, especially around how enterprise knowledge (DMS files, matter data, firm content) flows into and shapes AI-powered workflows.
  • Act as a bridge between India and HQ (San Francisco / New York), ensuring tight communication loops and strategic alignment across sites.
  • Contribute to shaping Harvey's India product culture — setting the bar for how PMs operate in the region.

What You Have

  • 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or Senior PM level at a high-growth technology company.
  • Demonstrated ability to own and drive a product area end-to-end, from strategy through execution and iteration.
  • Strong technical fluency — you can have deep, substantive conversations with engineers about system design, data pipelines, API architecture, and infrastructure trade-offs, including topics like vector search, orchestration systems, and sync reliability.
  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS go-to-market dynamics: customer commitments, partner integrations, access control and governance requirements, and the operational complexity of shipping to large law firms or regulated industries.
  • Track record of effective cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, GTM, and Customer Success — including navigating dependency-heavy roadmaps and partner relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to executives and external stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
  • Experience working in distributed or multi-site teams, with comfort operating across time zones.
  • Based in Bengaluru and eligible to work in India. Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in legal tech, professional services technology, or regulated industries.
  • Experience as a founding or early PM in a new-market or new-office setting.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI-native product design, and an intuition for how data quality and pipeline design affect AI output.

Additional Information

  • Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid-sized Banks and NBFCs. Education & experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 6 - 8 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 - 4 yrs experience should be in Micro/affordable loan sales.   • Job Purpose: Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2-3 lines) ( Max 1325 Characters)

The purpose of this job is to plan area (city/ branch) sales and business growth with the Territory Head (Sales) and achieve set targets through the team while complying with sales processes and guidelines at all times. It takes joint approval decisions with Risk counterpart as per approval matrix, and works with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure portfolio health. It works to support business profitability by addressing underperformance, adopting process improvements, capitalizing on channel optimization opportunities, etc. It intervenes as required in specific cases/ exceptions and helps address bottlenecks for the achievement of sales targets, hand-holding team members on complex cases. It also drives cross-selling across ABFL and ABFSG products/ solutions as per regional plans and unique client requirements.

  • Dimensions: Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.

Other Quantitative and Important Parameters for the job: Budgets/ Volumes/No. of Products/Geography/ Markets/ Customers or any other parameter

  • Job Context & Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section ( (Max 3975 Characters)

Organizational Context

Key Aspects:

  • As the debt arm of Aditya Birla Capital (ABC), offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid-sized Banks and NBFCs.
  • The company has a well-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space – spread across Retail HNI and corporate clientele. It has made significant investments in process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all business processes. Spread across 18 cities, it plans on further diversifying its risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing customers a one-window shop for all their financing needs.
  • Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABFL has ventured into Secured Micro Loan Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield and profit segment.

Job Context

Key Aspects:

  • The Secured Micro Loan Business segment product line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of Small Businesses and individuals, via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, with collateral.
  • Offerings comprise Secured Micro Loan to self-employed individuals/ non-individual entities, with end use of funds (Working capital requirement, business expansion etc.) to be ascertained during the loan appraisal process.
  • The business is highly retail in nature, characterized by high transaction volumes, smaller ticket sizes, and significantly higher spread and profit margins (up to four times that of Secured Lending products)
  • Given the Secured Micro Loan nature of loans disbursed, the business also entails stringent controls and monitoring to ensure portfolio health and quality at all times
  • While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are key business objectives.
  • Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to customers
  • Understanding of product market characteristics such as connector relationship management, region specific occupations/trade, local financial preferences and practices are important to gain competitive advantage while structuring loans and identifying leads.
  • The AH (Sales) – ABFL is responsible for achieving sales targets as agreed with the Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, in terms of targeted book size, profitability, growth & customer service objectives.

Key Challenges

  • To deliver on operational plan in the assigned coverage area in a differentiated manner considering local factors, channel dynamics and consumer preferences, that can withstand competitive pressures on the ground
  • To grow the business while remaining cognizant of competitive realities in the following areas:
  • Market linked product
  • Market average IRR & processing fee levels
  • To originate and increase market share in assigned coverage area against stiff competition, overcoming competitive pressures borne out of better established networks, price undercutting, etc.
  • To establish a strong local network and leverage the same to generate business leads, and also identify opportunities for cross sell with existing customers
  • To constantly upgrade financial & operational know how of self and team members on efficient loan processing, effective negotiation and relationship building for maintaining credibility and profitable target achievement
  • To keep abreast with the latest market trends and local market preferences and needs
  • To ensure loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization percentages are high and a broad enough sourcing funnel is built to meet targets
  • To ensure credit quality and effective portfolio selection/pre screening thereby minimizing potential NPAs

To ensure compliant sales operations despite sales pressures and market cycles

Enabling Skill Sets & Qualifications

  • Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, team management and communication, execution skills, product-market understanding, and operations integration & controlling skills.

Education & experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 6 - 8 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 - 4 yrs experience should be in Micro/affordable loan sales.

  • Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4- 7 key result areas)- Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated

Key Result Areas ( Max 1325 Characters)

Supporting Actions ( Max 1325 Characters)

Branch Sales Planning & Management

  • Work with Territory Head (Sales) - ABFL on devising the branch sales plan and team approach for achieving targets, considering product-environmental factors, competitive forces and local trends, and cascade the same to the branch team(s)
  • Track industry and market developments, scanning the local market and competitive offerings on a periodic basis
  • Oversee end to end branch operations and performance, covering all aspects such as sourcing, effectiveness, governance, productivity, channel management, etc.
  • Track & report on sales operations and productivity metrics, and work towards building a high-performance sales culture
  • Manage day-to-day branch operations and administration
  • Provide data for, compile and review periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, NPAs, market expansion, etc. and communicate to Territory Head (Sales) - ABFL as well as to team members

Customer Acquisition/ Engagement

  • o Identify local business growth opportunities, drive expansion and new customer acquisition initiatives to create a book of targeted size
  • o Work closely with team members, hand-holding critical/ complex transactions to ensure favorable closure with customer satisfaction
  • o Communicate sales targets and provide team members clarity on business goals, role expectations, product characteristics and USPs to enhance effectiveness of sales efforts
  • o Track cases in the complaint tracker/ escalations received, liaising with relevant stakeholders as required to drive satisfactory closure
  • o Deploy efforts/ initiatives in consultation with Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, arising from customer satisfaction survey and resulting NPS (Net Promoter Score), targeting identified focus areas
  • o Propose and deploy approved solutions and schemes to drive sales and enhance profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization
  • o Serve as a point of escalation and manage customer complaints/ grievances effectively, intervening especially for key relationships

Operational Effectiveness

  • To drive adoption of efficient business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)
  • Manage local distribution across channels, interfacing with senior/ critical partners/ stakeholders as required for smooth operations
  • Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance) and efficient operations
  • Drive high performance by reinforcing focus on business and sales growth objectives, effective client engagement, monitoring sales operations and productivity metrics, and providing support and guidance as required
  • Drive the implementation of improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business impact

Cross-Selling across ABFSG products

  • Drive activities and initiatives in the team as per Cross-Selling strategy agreed with Territory Head (Sales) - ABFL
  • Drive alignment to the adopted Cross-Selling strategy by supporting team members with requisite communications, training, guidance, etc. as required

Team and Internal Stakeholder Management

  • Guide and develop team members for enhanced customer acquisition and engagement efforts, helping them achieve superior performance standards and hand-holding where required
  • Nominate teams for relevant technical and behavioral trainings/ seminars and work on self development initiatives
  • Proactively liaise with internal stakeholders for smooth cross-functional coordination and alignment towards achievement of business objectives.

Portfolio & Risk Management

  • Work with the Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure adherence to risk management and control mechanisms
  • Support risk and review process through the credit approval process and by reviewing the loan sanctioning, disbursement process and documentation to ensure controlled operations
  • Review financial risk via analysis of city/ branch operations MIS and Data Analytics reports
  • Drive compliant Sales Operations and sound risk management via partnership with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams, and necessary communication and guidance; drive timely PDD closures and collections
  • As part of Relationship Maintenance with institutional customers, review reports on client accounts, business performance, etc. and liaise with Risk while guiding team on delinquency cases
  • Train and guide the team for alignment with adopted early alert strategies to reduce NPA risks and losses
  • Ensure systematic MIS on NPAs and credit trends, providing inputs on possible risks that could impact portfolio quality
  • Job Purpose of Direct Reports: Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2-3 lines for each report)

Relationship Officer/Relationship Manager :

Responsible for building book size as per assigned targets for the branch/ area, through efficient sales operations across the customer lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections), while ensuring sufficient sourcing funnel, revenue generation, profitability, MIS, portfolio management, as per desired levels; to ensure the end to end management of solutions and transactions with adequate credit quality monitoring of new acquisitions.

  • Job details

Job Information

  • Industry IT Services
  • Job Type Permanent
  • Work Experience 5-8 Years
  • City Pune City
  • State/Province Maharashtra
  • Country India
  • Zip/Postal Code 411001

About Us

CCTech's mission is to transform human life by the democratization of technology. We are a well established digital transformation company building the applications in the areas of CAD, CFD, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, 3D Webapps, Augmented Reality, Digital Twin, and other enterprise applications.

We have two business divisions: product and consulting.

simulationHub is our flagship product and the manifestation of our vision. Currently, thousands of users use our CFD app in their upfront design process.

Our consulting division, with its partners such as Autodesk Forge, AWS and Azure, is helping the world's leading engineering organizations, many of which are Fortune 500 list of companies, in achieving digital supremacy.

Job Description

About simulationHub

simulationHub is on a mission to democratize simulation technology. We build industry-specific SaaS applications on our cloud CFD platform, making high-fidelity engineering simulation accessible on any device — laptops, tablets, or smartphones.

Our Product Portfolio Spans Three Verticals

  • Autonomous Valve CFD (AVC) — Automated CFD analysis for valve manufacturers, replacing weeks of manual simulation with a self-driving workflow. 15–20+ paying subscribers across global markets including Bray International, Entech Controls, Flo-Tite, and GM Engineering.
  • Buildings AI — AI-powered LEED and ECBC energy compliance automation, turning $100K+ certification workflows into $500 automated assessments. First paid customer secured.
  • Fabric Duct Design Suite — Design and simulation tools for fabric duct manufacturers, launched with active partnership pipeline. We serve HVAC, architectural, valve, and building construction industries — helping leaders improve design performance early in the cycle and accelerate time-to-market.

The Role

This is not a "create some content and run campaigns" role. This is a leadership hire — the first dedicated product marketing leader for a business unit that has validated product-market fit across multiple verticals and now needs to build the commercial engine to scale from early traction to 100+ customers per product line.

You will own the entire product marketing function: positioning, go-to-market strategy, demand generation, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and brand building — across AVC, Buildings AI, and Fabric Duct.

You will work directly with the BU Head and engineering teams to shape product direction, drive launches, and grow adoption post-launch.

What You'll Do

Strategy & Positioning

  • Define and own product positioning, messaging, and value propositions for each product vertical (AVC, Buildings AI, Fabric Duct)
  • Develop go-to-market plans for new product launches, feature releases, and market expansions
  • Build competitive intelligence frameworks — track existing competions, and emerging cloud-native simulation tools
  • Define pricing and packaging strategy in collaboration with leadership

Demand Generation & Growth

  • Own the marketing funnel from awareness to MQL to sales handoff
  • Plan and execute campaigns across channels: webinars, workshops, email nurtures, content marketing, landing pages, social media, and industry events
  • Drive inbound lead generation through thought leadership content (LinkedIn, technical blogs, whitepapers, case studies)
  • Manage and optimize the website and digital presence for conversion

Sales Enablement

  • Build sales collateral: pitch decks, one-pagers, ROI calculators, competitive battle cards, demo scripts
  • Enable the sales process with prospect-ready materials that address buyer objections across different personas (CTOs, Design Heads, Sustainability Officers)
  • Support key deals with custom content and positioning guidance

Events & Industry Presence

  • Represent simulationHub at industry events (Valve World, ACREX, ASHRAE events, ISHRAE conferences)
  • Plan booth presence, speaking opportunities, and workshop delivery
  • Build relationships with industry associations (IVAMA, ASHRAE, ISHRAE)

Brand & Content

  • Build simulationHub's brand identity and voice across all touchpoints
  • Create and manage a content calendar that drives organic traffic and positions simulationHub as a thought leader in simulation democratization
  • Produce marketing content: case studies, application notes, video scripts, social media campaigns

Team Building

  • Build and lead a small, high-performing marketing and communications team over time
  • Manage external agencies, freelancers, and vendor relationships for specialized projects

Requirements

Who You Are

Must Have

  • Engineering background (Mechanical or related field) + MBA in Marketing/Communications (or equivalent experience)
  • 5–8 years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, preferably in technical/engineering software
  • Experience taking a product from early traction to growth stage — you've built the playbook, not just executed someone else's
  • Strong storytelling ability — you can translate deep technical concepts (CFD, thermal simulation, LEED compliance) into buyer-friendly narratives
  • Data-driven — you set KPIs, measure funnel performance, and iterate based on evidence
  • Hands-on digital marketing skills: SEO, email automation, LinkedIn campaigns, Google Ads, webinar platforms
  • Excellent communication and writing skills in English
  • Comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team where you own outcomes end to-end

Nice to Have

  • Domain knowledge of Building Simulation, HVAC, or Valve industries
  • Familiarity with the CAE/simulation software landscape
  • Experience marketing to global B2B buyers (North America, Europe, Middle East)
  • Understanding of LEED, ASHRAE 90.1, ECBC, or related green building standards
  • Experience with Zoho CRM/SalesIQ, HubSpot, or similar marketing automation platforms

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation: (based on experience and fitment)
  • Direct leadership role with high visibility and ownership
  • Opportunity to build the marketing function from the ground up for a product portfolio with validated global customers
  • Work at the intersection of AI, simulation, and sustainability — high-impact, high-growth space
  • Employee development, mentorship, and a defined career path

Benefits

  • Direct leadership role with high visibility and ownership
  • Opportunity to build the marketing function from the ground up for a product portfolio with validated global customers
  • Work at the intersection of AI, simulation, and sustainability — high-impact, high-growth space
  • Employee development, mentorship, and a defined career path

  • Job Purpose: Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2-3 lines) (Max 1325 Characters)

The purpose of this job is to plan area (city/ branch) sales and business growth with the Territory Head (Sales) and achieve set targets through the team while complying with sales processes and guidelines at all times. It takes joint approval decisions with Risk counterpart as per approval matrix, and works with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure portfolio health. It works to support business profitability by addressing underperformance, adopting process improvements, capitalizing on channel optimization opportunities, etc. It intervenes as required in specific cases/ exceptions and helps address bottlenecks for the achievement of sales targets, hand-holding team members on complex cases. It also drives cross-selling across ABFL and ABFSG products/ solutions as per regional plans and unique client requirements.

  • Dimensions: Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.

Other Quantitative and Important Parameters for the job: Budgets/ Volumes/No. of Products/Geography/ Markets/ Customers or any other parameter

  • Job Context & Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section ((Max 3975 Characters)

Organizational Context

Key Aspects:

  • As the debt arm of Aditya Birla Capital (ABC), offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid-sized Banks and NBFCs.
  • The company has a well-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space – spread across Retail HNI and corporate clientele. It has made significant investments in process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all business processes. Spread across 18 cities, it plans on further diversifying its risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing customers a one-window shop for all their financing needs.
  • Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABFL has ventured into Secured Micro Loan Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield and profit segment.

Job Context

Key Aspects:

  • The Secured Micro Loan Business segment product line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of Small Businesses and individuals, via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, with collateral.
  • Offerings comprise Secured Micro Loan to self-employed individuals/ non-individual entities, with end use of funds (Working capital requirement, business expansion etc.) to be ascertained during the loan appraisal process.
  • The business is highly retail in nature, characterized by high transaction volumes, smaller ticket sizes, and significantly higher spread and profit margins (up to four times that of Secured Lending products)
  • Given the Secured Micro Loan nature of loans disbursed, the business also entails stringent controls and monitoring to ensure portfolio health and quality at all times
  • While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are key business objectives.
  • Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to customers
  • Understanding of product market characteristics such as connector relationship management, region specific occupations/trade, local financial preferences and practices are important to gain competitive advantage while structuring loans and identifying leads.
  • The AH (Sales) – ABFL is responsible for achieving sales targets as agreed with the Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, in terms of targeted book size, profitability, growth & customer service objectives.

Key Challenges

  • To deliver on operational plan in the assigned coverage area in a differentiated manner considering local factors, channel dynamics and consumer preferences, that can withstand competitive pressures on the ground
  • To grow the business while remaining cognizant of competitive realities in the following areas:
  • Market linked product
  • Market average IRR & processing fee levels
  • To originate and increase market share in assigned coverage area against stiff competition, overcoming competitive pressures borne out of better established networks, price undercutting, etc.
  • To establish a strong local network and leverage the same to generate business leads, and also identify opportunities for cross sell with existing customers
  • To constantly upgrade financial & operational know how of self and team members on efficient loan processing, effective negotiation and relationship building for maintaining credibility and profitable target achievement
  • To keep abreast with the latest market trends and local market preferences and needs
  • To ensure loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization percentages are high and a broad enough sourcing funnel is built to meet targets
  • To ensure credit quality and effective portfolio selection/pre screening thereby minimizing potential NPAs

To ensure compliant sales operations despite sales pressures and market cycles

Enabling Skill Sets & Qualifications

  • Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, team management and communication, execution skills, product-market understanding, and operations integration & controlling skills.

Education & experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 6 - 8 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 - 4 yrs experience should be in Micro/affordable loan sales.

Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)

Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

  • Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4- 7 key result areas)- Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated

Branch Sales Planning & Management

  • Work with Territory Head (Sales) - ABFL on devising the branch sales plan and team approach for achieving targets, considering product-environmental factors, competitive forces and local trends, and cascade the same to the branch team(s)
  • Track industry and market developments, scanning the local market and competitive offerings on a periodic basis
  • Oversee end to end branch operations and performance, covering all aspects such as sourcing, effectiveness, governance, productivity, channel management, etc.
  • Track & report on sales operations and productivity metrics, and work towards building a high-performance sales culture
  • Manage day-to-day branch operations and administration
  • Provide data for, compile and review periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, NPAs, market expansion, etc. and communicate to Territory Head (Sales) - ABFL as well as to team members

Customer Acquisition/ Engagement

  • o Identify local business growth opportunities, drive expansion and new customer acquisition initiatives to create a book of targeted size
  • o Work closely with team members, hand-holding critical/ complex transactions to ensure favorable closure with customer satisfaction
  • o Communicate sales targets and provide team members clarity on business goals, role expectations, product characteristics and USPs to enhance effectiveness of sales efforts
  • o Track cases in the complaint tracker/ escalations received, liaising with relevant stakeholders as required to drive satisfactory closure
  • o Deploy efforts/ initiatives in consultation with Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, arising from customer satisfaction survey and resulting NPS (Net Promoter Score), targeting identified focus areas
  • o Propose and deploy approved solutions and schemes to drive sales and enhance profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization
  • o Serve as a point of escalation and manage customer complaints/ grievances effectively, intervening especially for key relationships

Operational Effectiveness

  • To drive adoption of efficient business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)
  • Manage local distribution across channels, interfacing with senior/ critical partners/ stakeholders as required for smooth operations
  • Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance) and efficient operations
  • Drive high performance by reinforcing focus on business and sales growth objectives, effective client engagement, monitoring sales operations and productivity metrics, and providing support and guidance as required
  • Drive the implementation of improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business impact

Cross-Selling across ABFSG products

  • Drive activities and initiatives in the team as per Cross-Selling strategy agreed with Territory Head (Sales) - ABFL
  • Drive alignment to the adopted Cross-Selling strategy by supporting team members with requisite communications, training, guidance, etc. as required

Team and Internal Stakeholder Management

  • Guide and develop team members for enhanced customer acquisition and engagement efforts, helping them achieve superior performance standards and hand-holding where required
  • Nominate teams for relevant technical and behavioral trainings/ seminars and work on self development initiatives
  • Proactively liaise with internal stakeholders for smooth cross-functional coordination and alignment towards achievement of business objectives.

Portfolio & Risk Management

  • Work with the Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure adherence to risk management and control mechanisms
  • Support risk and review process through the credit approval process and by reviewing the loan sanctioning, disbursement process and documentation to ensure controlled operations
  • Review financial risk via analysis of city/ branch operations MIS and Data Analytics reports
  • Drive compliant Sales Operations and sound risk management via partnership with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams, and necessary communication and guidance; drive timely PDD closures and collections
  • As part of Relationship Maintenance with institutional customers, review reports on client accounts, business performance, etc. and liaise with Risk while guiding team on delinquency cases
  • Train and guide the team for alignment with adopted early alert strategies to reduce NPA risks and losses
  • Ensure systematic MIS on NPAs and credit trends, providing inputs on possible risks that could impact portfolio quality
  • Job Purpose of Direct Reports: Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2-3 lines for each report)

Relationship Officer/Relationship Manager :

Responsible for building book size as per assigned targets for the branch/ area, through efficient sales operations across the customer lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections), while ensuring sufficient sourcing funnel, revenue generation, profitability, MIS, portfolio management, as per desired levels; to ensure the end to end management of solutions and transactions with adequate credit quality monitoring of new acquisitions.

descriptionHtml:
About CreditMitra

CreditMitra is a trust-first fintech platform serving India's salaried professionals. Having normalized the "bridge loan" as a financial planning tool, we are now expanding our ecosystem to include insurance products that protect our users from life's unexpected moments.


The Role

We are seeking a Business Head of Insurance with 9+ years of experience to own this vertical from the ground up. You will define the roadmap, manage P&L, and lead strategic partnerships, ensuring our insurance products maintain the "dignity-forward" positioning that defines the CreditMitra brand.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Vertical Ownership: Define the end-to-end strategy and product roadmap for the insurance vertical for 2026 and beyond.


  • Strategic Partnerships: Secure and manage high-level relationships with RBI-backed NBFCs and insurance providers to offer exclusive, transparent products.


  • B2B Outreach: Partner with HR Directors and Finance Managers at Tier 1 companies to offer CreditMitra insurance as a corporate financial benefit.


  • Team Building and Thought Leadership: Build and lead a team of geographical and functional leads & Serve as a subject matter expert for Insurance and help draft whitepapers and leadership articles


  • Revenue Growth: Take full responsibility for the insurance P&L, scaling the vertical across geographies


  • Compliance Management: Ensure all offerings align with IRDAI/RBI guidelines and our internal "human-over-corporate" quality standards.


What We’re Looking For

  • 9+ years of experience in the insurance or fintech sectors, with a history of scaling new business units.
  • Deep understanding of the Indian insurance landscape and regulatory requirements.
  • Exceptional B2B negotiation skills and the ability to build "trust-first" corporate relationships.


A "dignity-first" leadership style, framing insurance as an act of planning and self-sufficiency.


Details

Role Type: Full-time, On-site

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Reporting to: MD/CEO

descriptionHtml:
Position Summary:

The Head Bancassurance is responsible for driving and scaling up insurance business across the various channels within the organization. He / She will be product lead for Group credit life and general insurance.


Role & Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy to integrate, scale, and grow the Life and General Insurance business within the organization.
  • Drive maximum penetration of insurance products, including Life and General across customer segments.
  • Ensure strict compliance with IRDAI guidelines and internal governance frameworks.
  • Conduct regular governance meetings, reviews, and performance evaluations with internal stakeholders and insurance partners, as per business requirements.
  • Ensure 100% adherence to defined sales management processes and control mechanisms.
  • Collaborate closely with insurance partners to deliver best-in-class products, operations, and technology solutions, enabling seamless and simplified business execution.
  • Liaise with insurance partners and cross-functional internal teams to design new processes and enhance existing workflows, including end-to-end IT integration and business process enablement.
  • Closely monitor claims management and settlement processes, ensuring adherence to defined TATs and service levels.
  • Lead the innovation and development of new insurance products tailored to varied portfolios and customer needs.
  • Oversee reconciliation (Recon) management to ensure accuracy, transparency, and timely resolution.
  • Engage regularly with operations teams and branch networks to ensure smooth execution and consistent process delivery on the ground.
  • Keep senior management informed on market trends, benchmarking insights, and insurance industry best practices.
  • Partner with insurance providers to drive training initiatives, manpower support, product enhancements, technology adoption, cross-sell analytics, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications and Skills

  • MBA from an Institute of repute.
  • 10 + years of Total Experience.
  • 5-6 years in similar roles with Zonal/National exposure having managed large portfolios across insurance & cross functional team.
  • Should have micro finance industry exposure.
  • Strong leadership quality | Good Business Acumen | Sharp Analytical skills |
  • Ability to build a Team | Excellent communication skills.
