descriptionHtml:
• Job Purpose: Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2-3 lines) ( Max 1325 Characters)

The purpose of this job is to plan area (city/ branch) sales and business growth with the Circle Head (Sales) and achieve set targets through the team while complying with sales processes and guidelines at all times. It takes joint approval decisions with Risk counterpart as per approval matrix, and works with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure portfolio health. It works to support business profitability by addressing underperformance, adopting process improvements, capitalizing on channel optimization opportunities, etc. It intervenes as required in specific cases/ exceptions and helps address bottlenecks for the achievement of sales targets, hand-holding team members on complex cases. It also drives cross-selling across ABFL and ABFSG products/ solutions as per regional plans and unique client requirements.

  • Job Context & Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section ( (Max 3975 Characters)

Organizational Context

Key Aspects:

  • As the debt arm of Aditya Birla Capital (ABC), Aditya Birla Finance Limited (ABFL) offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid-sized Banks and NBFCs.
  • The company has a well-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space – spread across Retail HNI and corporate clientele. It has made significant investments in process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all business processes. Spread across 18 cities, it plans on further diversifying its risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing customers a one-window shop for all their financing needs.
  • Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABFL has ventured into Secured Micro Loan Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield and profit segment.

Job Context

Key Aspects:

  • The Secured Micro Loan Business segment product line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of Small Businesses and individuals, via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, with collateral.
  • Offerings comprise Secured Micro Loan to self-employed individuals/ non-individual entities, with end use of funds (Working capital requirement, business expansion etc.) to be ascertained during the loan appraisal process.
  • The business is highly retail in nature, characterized by high transaction volumes, smaller ticket sizes, and significantly higher spread and profit margins (up to four times that of Secured Lending products)
  • Given the Secured Micro Loan nature of loans disbursed, the business also entails stringent controls and monitoring to ensure portfolio health and quality at all times
  • While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are key business objectives.
  • Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to customers
  • Understanding of product market characteristics such as connector relationship management, region specific occupations/trade, local financial preferences and practices are important to gain competitive advantage while structuring loans and identifying leads.
  • The AH (Sales) – ABFL is responsible for achieving sales targets as agreed with the Circle Head (Sales) – ABFL, in terms of targeted book size, profitability, growth & customer service objectives.

Key Challenges

  • To deliver on operational plan in the assigned coverage area in a differentiated manner considering local factors, channel dynamics and consumer preferences, that can withstand competitive pressures on the ground
  • To grow the business while remaining cognizant of competitive realities in the following areas:
  • Market linked product
  • Market average IRR & processing fee levels
  • To originate and increase market share in assigned coverage area against stiff competition, overcoming competitive pressures borne out of better established networks, price undercutting, etc.
  • To establish a strong local network and leverage the same to generate business leads, and also identify opportunities for cross sell with existing customers
  • To constantly upgrade financial & operational know how of self and team members on efficient loan processing, effective negotiation and relationship building for maintaining credibility and profitable target achievement
  • To keep abreast with the latest market trends and local market preferences and needs
  • To ensure loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization percentages are high and a broad enough sourcing funnel is built to meet targets
  • To ensure credit quality and effective portfolio selection/pre screening thereby minimizing potential NPAs

To ensure compliant sales operations despite sales pressures and market cycles

Enabling Skill Sets & Qualifications

  • Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, team management and communication, execution skills, product-market understanding, and operations integration & controlling skills.

Education & experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 6 - 8 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 - 4 yrs experience should be in Micro/affordable loan sales.

  • Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4- 7 key result areas)- Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated

Key Result Areas ( Max 1325 Characters)

Supporting Actions ( Max 1325 Characters)

Branch Sales Planning & Management

  • Work with Circle Head (Sales) - ABFL on devising the branch sales plan and team approach for achieving targets, considering product-environmental factors, competitive forces and local trends, and cascade the same to the branch team(s)
  • Track industry and market developments, scanning the local market and competitive offerings on a periodic basis
  • Oversee end to end branch operations and performance, covering all aspects such as sourcing, effectiveness, governance, productivity, channel management, etc.
  • Track & report on sales operations and productivity metrics, and work towards building a high-performance sales culture
  • Manage day-to-day branch operations and administration
  • Provide data for, compile and review periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, NPAs, market expansion, etc. and communicate to Circle Head (Sales) - ABFL as well as to team members

Customer Acquisition/ Engagement

  • o Identify local business growth opportunities, drive expansion and new customer acquisition initiatives to create a book of targeted size
  • o Work closely with team members, hand-holding critical/ complex transactions to ensure favorable closure with customer satisfaction
  • o Communicate sales targets and provide team members clarity on business goals, role expectations, product characteristics and USPs to enhance effectiveness of sales efforts
  • o Track cases in the complaint tracker/ escalations received, liaising with relevant stakeholders as required to drive satisfactory closure
  • o Deploy efforts/ initiatives in consultation with Circle Head (Sales) – ABFL, arising from customer satisfaction survey and resulting NPS (Net Promoter Score), targeting identified focus areas
  • o Propose and deploy approved solutions and schemes to drive sales and enhance profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization
  • o Serve as a point of escalation and manage customer complaints/ grievances effectively, intervening especially for key relationships

Operational Effectiveness

  • To drive adoption of efficient business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)
  • Manage local distribution across channels, interfacing with senior/ critical partners/ stakeholders as required for smooth operations
  • Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance) and efficient operations
  • Drive high performance by reinforcing focus on business and sales growth objectives, effective client engagement, monitoring sales operations and productivity metrics, and providing support and guidance as required
  • Drive the implementation of improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business impact

Cross-Selling across ABFSG products

  • Drive activities and initiatives in the team as per Cross-Selling strategy agreed with Circle Head (Sales) - ABFL
  • Drive alignment to the adopted Cross-Selling strategy by supporting team members with requisite communications, training, guidance, etc. as required

Team and Internal Stakeholder Management

  • Guide and develop team members for enhanced customer acquisition and engagement efforts, helping them achieve superior performance standards and hand-holding where required
  • Nominate teams for relevant technical and behavioral trainings/ seminars and work on self development initiatives
  • Proactively liaise with internal stakeholders for smooth cross-functional coordination and alignment towards achievement of business objectives.

Portfolio & Risk Management

  • Work with the Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure adherence to risk management and control mechanisms
  • Support risk and review process through the credit approval process and by reviewing the loan sanctioning, disbursement process and documentation to ensure controlled operations
  • Review financial risk via analysis of city/ branch operations MIS and Data Analytics reports
  • Drive compliant Sales Operations and sound risk management via partnership with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams, and necessary communication and guidance; drive timely PDD closures and collections
  • As part of Relationship Maintenance with institutional customers, review reports on client accounts, business performance, etc. and liaise with Risk while guiding team on delinquency cases
  • Train and guide the team for alignment with adopted early alert strategies to reduce NPA risks and losses
  • Ensure systematic MIS on NPAs and credit trends, providing inputs on possible risks that could impact portfolio quality
  • Job Purpose of Direct Reports: Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2-3 lines for each report)

Area Head :

Responsible for building book size as per assigned targets for the branch/ area, through efficient sales operations across the customer lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections), while ensuring sufficient sourcing funnel, revenue generation, profitability, MIS, portfolio management, as per desired levels; to ensure the end to end management of solutions and transactions with adequate credit quality monitoring of new acquisitions.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Payments based in India.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for shaping and scaling the global payments function across multiple markets. You will own the end-to-end payments ecosystem, ensuring it is efficient, reliable, and optimised for growth and customer experience. The role spans strategy, operations, and product optimisation, with direct influence on conversion rates and revenue performance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to drive payment innovation and localisation. This position requires strong analytical capability, commercial acumen, and deep payments expertise. You will also lead provider relationships and negotiations to improve performance and reduce costs. It is a highly strategic yet hands-on role in a fast-scaling, international environment.

Accountabilities

  • Define and execute the global payments strategy aligned with broader business growth objectives.
  • Own and optimise the end-to-end payments ecosystem, including PSPs, cards, wallets, bank transfers, and alternative payment methods.
  • Improve payment UX/UI to reduce friction, increase conversion, and enhance customer payment journeys.
  • Optimise routing logic, provider allocation, and transaction flows to maximise approval rates and reduce costs.
  • Monitor payment performance across markets, issuers, and providers, identifying trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Manage PSP relationships, negotiations, and commercial agreements to ensure optimal pricing, reliability, and service levels.
  • Drive payment localisation initiatives, including local acquiring and market-specific payment methods.
  • Lead PSP evaluations, integrations, and ongoing performance management.
  • Build and maintain robust reporting frameworks for payment performance, cost efficiency, and reliability metrics.
  • Ensure compliance with payment regulations, security standards, and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with Product, Tech, Finance, Operations, and Support teams to enhance end-to-end payment systems.
  • Establish scalable processes, documentation, and operational controls.
  • Lead and develop the payments team, setting goals and enabling professional growth.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience in payments, fintech, or financial services in a global or multi-market environment.
  • Strong background in payment systems, PSPs, acquiring, routing optimisation, and transaction lifecycle management.
  • Proven ability to improve payment performance metrics such as approval rates, conversion, and cost efficiency.
  • Experience negotiating and managing relationships with PSPs, banks, and payment partners.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret payment data and drive actionable insights.
  • Solid understanding of payment compliance, security standards, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Product-minded approach with an understanding of payment UX and customer journey optimisation.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, and Finance.
  • Strong leadership experience, including building and scaling high-performing teams.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.
  • Opportunity to lead and scale a global payments function with significant business impact.
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote/hybrid depending on structure).
  • Health insurance and wellness support programs.
  • Learning and development budget to support professional growth.
  • Exposure to international markets and complex payment ecosystems.
  • Collaborative, high-growth environment with strong ownership culture.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information.   • Job Context & Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section ( (Max 3975 Characters)

Organizational Context

Key Aspects:

  • As the debt arm of Aditya Birla Capital (ABC), Aditya Birla Finance Limited (ABCL) offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABCL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid-sized Banks and NBFCs.
  • The company has a well-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space – spread across Retail HNI and corporate clientele. It has made significant investments in process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all business processes. Spread across 18 cities, it plans on further diversifying its risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing customers a one-window shop for all their financing needs.
  • Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABCL has ventured into Secured Micro Loan Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield and profit segment.

Job Context

Key Aspects:

  • The Secured Micro Loan Business segment product line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of Small Businesses and individuals, via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, with collateral.
  • Offerings comprise Secured Micro Loan to self-employed individuals/ non-individual entities, with end use of funds (Working capital requirement, business expansion etc.) to be ascertained during the loan appraisal process.
  • The business is highly retail in nature, characterized by high transaction volumes, smaller ticket sizes, and significantly higher spread and profit margins (up to four times that of Secured Lending products)
  • Given the Secured Micro Loan nature of loans disbursed, the business also entails stringent controls and monitoring to ensure portfolio health and quality at all times
  • While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are key business objectives.
  • Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to customers
  • Understanding of product market characteristics such as connector relationship management, region specific occupations/trade, local financial preferences and practices are important to gain competitive advantage while structuring loans and identifying leads.
  • The AH (Sales) – ABCL is responsible for achieving sales targets as agreed with the Territory Head (Sales) – ABCL, in terms of targeted book size, profitability, growth & customer service objectives.

Key Challenges

  • To deliver on operational plan in the assigned coverage area in a differentiated manner considering local factors, channel dynamics and consumer preferences, that can withstand competitive pressures on the ground
  • To grow the business while remaining cognizant of competitive realities in the following areas:
  • Market linked product
  • Market average IRR & processing fee levels
  • To originate and increase market share in assigned coverage area against stiff competition, overcoming competitive pressures borne out of better established networks, price undercutting, etc.
  • To establish a strong local network and leverage the same to generate business leads, and also identify opportunities for cross sell with existing customers
  • To constantly upgrade financial & operational know how of self and team members on efficient loan processing, effective negotiation and relationship building for maintaining credibility and profitable target achievement
  • To keep abreast with the latest market trends and local market preferences and needs
  • To ensure loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization percentages are high and a broad enough sourcing funnel is built to meet targets
  • To ensure credit quality and effective portfolio selection/pre screening thereby minimizing potential NPAs

To ensure compliant sales operations despite sales pressures and market cycles

Enabling Skill Sets & Qualifications

  • Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, team management and communication, execution skills, product-market understanding, and operations integration & controlling skills.

Education & experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 6 - 8 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 - 4 yrs experience should be in Micro/affordable loan sales.

  • Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4- 7 key result areas)- Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated

Key Result Areas ( Max 1325 Characters)

Supporting Actions ( Max 1325 Characters)

Branch Sales Planning & Management

  • Work with Territory Head (Sales) - ABCL on devising the branch sales plan and team approach for achieving targets, considering product-environmental factors, competitive forces and local trends, and cascade the same to the branch team(s)
  • Track industry and market developments, scanning the local market and competitive offerings on a periodic basis
  • Oversee end to end branch operations and performance, covering all aspects such as sourcing, effectiveness, governance, productivity, channel management, etc.
  • Track & report on sales operations and productivity metrics, and work towards building a high-performance sales culture
  • Manage day-to-day branch operations and administration
  • Provide data for, compile and review periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, NPAs, market expansion, etc. and communicate to Territory Head (Sales) - ABCL as well as to team members

Customer Acquisition/ Engagement

  • Identify local business growth opportunities, drive expansion and new customer acquisition initiatives to create a book of targeted size
  • Work closely with team members, hand-holding critical/ complex transactions to ensure favorable closure with customer satisfaction
  • Communicate sales targets and provide team members clarity on business goals, role expectations, product characteristics and USPs to enhance effectiveness of sales efforts
  • Track cases in the complaint tracker/ escalations received, liaising with relevant stakeholders as required to drive satisfactory closure
  • Deploy efforts/ initiatives in consultation with Territory Head (Sales) – ABCL, arising from customer satisfaction survey and resulting NPS (Net Promoter Score), targeting identified focus areas
  • Propose and deploy approved solutions and schemes to drive sales and enhance profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization
  • Serve as a point of escalation and manage customer complaints/ grievances effectively, intervening especially for key relationships

Operational Effectiveness

  • To drive adoption of efficient business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)
  • Manage local distribution across channels, interfacing with senior/ critical partners/ stakeholders as required for smooth operations
  • Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance) and efficient operations
  • Drive high performance by reinforcing focus on business and sales growth objectives, effective client engagement, monitoring sales operations and productivity metrics, and providing support and guidance as required
  • Drive the implementation of improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business impact

Cross-Selling across ABFSG products

  • Drive activities and initiatives in the team as per Cross-Selling strategy agreed with Territory Head (Sales) - ABCL
  • Drive alignment to the adopted Cross-Selling strategy by supporting team members with requisite communications, training, guidance, etc. as required

Team and Internal Stakeholder Management

  • Guide and develop team members for enhanced customer acquisition and engagement efforts, helping them achieve superior performance standards and hand-holding where required
  • Nominate teams for relevant technical and behavioral trainings/ seminars and work on self development initiatives
  • Proactively liaise with internal stakeholders for smooth cross-functional coordination and alignment towards achievement of business objectives.

Portfolio & Risk Management

  • Work with the Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure adherence to risk management and control mechanisms
  • Support risk and review process through the credit approval process and by reviewing the loan sanctioning, disbursement process and documentation to ensure controlled operations
  • Review financial risk via analysis of city/ branch operations MIS and Data Analytics reports
  • Drive compliant Sales Operations and sound risk management via partnership with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams, and necessary communication and guidance; drive timely PDD closures and collections
  • As part of Relationship Maintenance with institutional customers, review reports on client accounts, business performance, etc. and liaise with Risk while guiding team on delinquency cases
  • Train and guide the team for alignment with adopted early alert strategies to reduce NPA risks and losses
  • Ensure systematic MIS on NPAs and credit trends, providing inputs on possible risks that could impact portfolio quality

Job Description

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Executive Director to lead our Securities Services Data Platform product team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in data lake technologies—especially Databricks—product management, and the securities services domain. This leadership role will drive the strategy, development, and delivery of our data lake solutions, partnering closely with engineering, operations, and business teams. The Executive Director will oversee a team including Vice Presidents and Analysts, providing strategic direction and mentorship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap: Execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Securities Services Data Lake, aligning with business objectives and client needs. Guide the team in prioritizing initiatives and delivering value.
  • Technical Leadership: Provide hands-on guidance in data lake architecture, data ingestion, processing, and analytics, with a strong focus on Databricks. Lead collaboration with engineering teams to design scalable and robust solutions.
  • Team Management & Mentorship: Manage and mentor a team of Vice Presidents and Analysts, fostering a culture of data excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Data Quality & Lineage: Champion best practices for data quality, data lineage, and metadata management. Implement frameworks and tools to ensure data integrity, traceability, and transparency across the data lake.
  • Stakeholder Management: Engage with internal and external stakeholders, including business users, technology teams, and clients, to gather requirements and prioritize features. Represent the team in senior leadership forums.
  • Delivery & Execution: Oversee end-to-end product delivery, from concept to deployment, ensuring high-quality releases and continuous improvement across all data lake initiatives.
  • Data Governance & Compliance: Ensure data quality, security, and compliance with regulatory requirements, setting standards and monitoring adherence across the team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in product management, data engineering, or related roles, with significant exposure to data lake technologies (e.g., Databricks, Hadoop, Spark, AWS, Azure).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (databricks, snowflake etc), including building and managing scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions.
  • Strong background in securities services, financial data, or capital markets.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex, large-scale data solutions in a leadership capacity.

descriptionHtml:
Vodafone Idea Limited is an Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group partnership. It is India’s leading telecom service provider. The Company provides pan India Voice and Data services across 2G, 3G and 4G platform. With the large spectrum portfolio to support the growing demand for data and voice, the company is committed to deliver delightful customer experiences and contribute towards creating a truly ‘Digital India’ by enabling millions of citizens to connect and build a better tomorrow. The Company is developing infrastructure to introduce newer and smarter technologies, making both retail and enterprise customers future ready with innovative offerings, conveniently accessible through an ecosystem of digital channels as well as extensive on-ground presence. The Company is listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.

VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. Consequently, our recruiting efforts are directed towards attracting and retaining best and brightest talents. Our endeavour is to be First Choice for prospective employees.

VIL ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, colour, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.

Role

Product Head – IOT & Platform

Job Level/ Designation

GM/M3

Function / Department

VIBS - IOT Business

Location

Mumbai

Job Purpose

Role purpose:

  • Lead the end-to-end New Product Development (NPD) lifecycle, from initial ideation to commercial launch, for next-generation IoT platforms and solutions spanning Connected Cars, Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), and Industry 4.0.
  • Direct a dedicated team of 4-5 product professionals to architect, build, and scale core platform capabilities across Connectivity Management Platforms (CMP), Device Management Platforms (DMS), and Application Enablement Platforms (AEP).
  • Serve as the organizational Center of Excellence (CoE) for scalable IoT architectures, translating evolving enterprise needs into innovative, revenue-generating digital propositions.
  • Drive cross-functional execution with Network, IT, Legal, Finance, and Vodafone Group teams to ensure swift, compliant, and time-bound product rollouts.


Key Result Areas/Accountabilities

  • NPD Execution & Lifecycle Management : Formulate the long-term innovation roadmap and spearhead the complete execution of new products. Establish robust development gates for Connected Vehicles, Smart Utilities (AMI), and Remote Asset Monitoring.
  • Platform & Capability Roadmap : Architect and manage cellular IoT monetization layers by leveraging advanced CMP capabilities, secure DMP frameworks, and feature-rich AEP architectures to host diverse vertical use cases.
  • Revenue & Commercial Ownership : Analyze market trends and cost dynamics in India to launch high-margin propositions. Create detailed budget plans, CapEx/OpEx business cases, and retain ultimate accountability for portfolio revenue.
  • Pre-Sales & Deal Conversion : Actively champion high-value sales pursuits, RFPs, and RFXs. Partner with the domain consulting and account management teams to convert strategic pipeline opportunities.
  • Pilots & SLA Delivery : Design, deploy, and monitor complex customer Proof of Concepts (POCs) and pilots. Ensure all deployed solutions adhere to rigorous data security frameworks and stringent enterprise Service Level Agreements (SLAs).


Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience

  • NPD Framework Mastery : Proven expertise managing product engineering lifecycle frameworks, agile scrum development pipelines, and cross-functional technology integrations.
  • Deep Platform Architecture Expertise : Thorough understanding of multi-tier IoT stacks, specifically Connectivity Management (CMP), Device Management (DMP), and Application Enablement (AEP) frameworks.
  • Vertical Domain Authority : Proven exposure designing use cases in Connected Cars (telematics, infotainment, V2X), AMI (smart metering, head-end systems), and Industry 4.0 (predictive maintenance, smart manufacturing).
  • Commercial Acumen : Deep understanding of the Indian IoT enterprise landscape, hardware/connectivity cost components, and cloud pricing models to build profitable architectures.
  • Technical Versatility : Comprehensive understanding of IoT interdependencies across hardware modules, eSIM/cellular profiles, edge gateway logic, and cloud integrations.


Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications

  • Engineering Graduate / Post Graduate in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunications, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering. MBA or equivalent business degree is a strong advantage.


Years Of Experience

  • 10 -15 years of core industry experience with strong exposure to product development, pre-sales engineering, or solution selling within the enterprise IoT, Telecom, or Automation sectors.
  • Strong track record of leading development teams or handling people management responsibilities within product development labs.
  • Hands-on experience scaling solutions on industry-leading IoT platforms (e.g., PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Central).
  • Proven track record of executing structured GTM strategies and partner alliances across the utility, automotive, or heavy asset manufacturing ecosystems.


Industries to look from

 Telecom & Platform Giants : Jio, Airtel, Vodafone Idea competitors, global telco IoT divisions.

  • System Integrators (Digital Practice) : TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, HCL.
  • Industrial Automation & Utility OEM Players : Siemens, Schneider Electric, GE T&D, Hitachi Energy, Honeywell, ABB, L&T.
  • Connected Car / Automotive Tech Centers : Bosch, Continental, KPIT, Harman, automotive OEM digital wings.


Direct reports

2-4

Vodafone Idea Limited (formerly Idea Cellular Limited)

An Aditya Birla Group & Vodafone partnership

Organizational Context

Key Aspects:

  • As the debt arm of Aditya Birla Capital (ABC), offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid-sized Banks and NBFCs.
  • The company has a well-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space – spread across Retail HNI and corporate clientele. It has made significant investments in process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all business processes. Spread across 18 cities, it plans on further diversifying its risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing customers a one-window shop for all their financing needs.
  • Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABFL has ventured into Secured Micro Loan Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield and profit segment.

Job Context

Key Aspects:

  • The Secured Micro Loan Business segment product line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of Small Businesses and individuals, via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, with collateral.
  • Offerings comprise Secured Micro Loan to self-employed individuals/ non-individual entities, with end use of funds (Working capital requirement, business expansion etc.) to be ascertained during the loan appraisal process.
  • The business is highly retail in nature, characterized by high transaction volumes, smaller ticket sizes, and significantly higher spread and profit margins (up to four times that of Secured Lending products)
  • Given the Secured Micro Loan nature of loans disbursed, the business also entails stringent controls and monitoring to ensure portfolio health and quality at all times
  • While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are key business objectives.
  • Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to customers
  • Understanding of product market characteristics such as connector relationship management, region specific occupations/trade, local financial preferences and practices are important to gain competitive advantage while structuring loans and identifying leads.
  • The AH (Sales) – ABFL is responsible for achieving sales targets as agreed with the Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, in terms of targeted book size, profitability, growth & customer service objectives.

Key Challenges

  • To deliver on operational plan in the assigned coverage area in a differentiated manner considering local factors, channel dynamics and consumer preferences, that can withstand competitive pressures on the ground
  • To grow the business while remaining cognizant of competitive realities in the following areas:
  • Market linked product
  • Market average IRR & processing fee levels
  • To originate and increase market share in assigned coverage area against stiff competition, overcoming competitive pressures borne out of better established networks, price undercutting, etc.
  • To establish a strong local network and leverage the same to generate business leads, and also identify opportunities for cross sell with existing customers
  • To constantly upgrade financial & operational know how of self and team members on efficient loan processing, effective negotiation and relationship building for maintaining credibility and profitable target achievement
  • To keep abreast with the latest market trends and local market preferences and needs
  • To ensure loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization percentages are high and a broad enough sourcing funnel is built to meet targets
  • To ensure credit quality and effective portfolio selection/pre screening thereby minimizing potential NPAs

To ensure compliant sales operations despite sales pressures and market cycles

Enabling Skill Sets & Qualifications

  • Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, team management and communication, execution skills, product-market understanding, and operations integration & controlling skills.

Education & experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 6 - 8 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 - 4 yrs experience should be in Micro/affordable loan sales.

  • Manage day-to-day branch operations and administration
  • Provide data for, compile and review periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, NPAs, market expansion, etc. and communicate to Territory Head (Sales) - ABFL as well as to team members

  • o Identify local business growth opportunities, drive expansion and new customer acquisition initiatives to create a book of targeted size
  • o Work closely with team members, hand-holding critical/ complex transactions to ensure favorable closure with customer satisfaction
  • o Communicate sales targets and provide team members clarity on business goals, role expectations, product characteristics and USPs to enhance effectiveness of sales efforts
  • o Track cases in the complaint tracker/ escalations received, liaising with relevant stakeholders as required to drive satisfactory closure
  • o Deploy efforts/ initiatives in consultation with Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, arising from customer satisfaction survey and resulting NPS (Net Promoter Score), targeting identified focus areas
  • o Propose and deploy approved solutions and schemes to drive sales and enhance profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization
  • o Serve as a point of escalation and manage customer complaints/ grievances effectively, intervening especially for key relationships

Operational Effectiveness

  • To drive adoption of efficient business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)
  • Manage local distribution across channels, interfacing with senior/ critical partners/ stakeholders as required for smooth operations
  • Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance) and efficient operations
  • Drive high performance by reinforcing focus on business and sales growth objectives, effective client engagement, monitoring sales operations and productivity metrics, and providing support and guidance as required
  • Drive the implementation of improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business impact

Cross-Selling across ABFSG products

  • Drive activities and initiatives in the team as per Cross-Selling strategy agreed with Territory Head (Sales) - ABFL
  • Drive alignment to the adopted Cross-Selling strategy by supporting team members with requisite communications, training, guidance, etc. as required

Team and Internal Stakeholder Management

Skills: Engineering Leadership, Product Engineering, Cloud Architecture, Microservices, DevOps, ERP Integrations, eCommerce Platforms, AI/ML, Enterprise Systems, Technology Strategy

Work Type: Full-Time / Onsite

About The Company

  • We are hiring on behalf of a fast-growing technology organization delivering innovative software solutions across eCommerce, Procurement, ERP Integrations, Sustainability/ESG, and Business Services domains. The company is focused on building scalable, cloud-native platforms and driving digital transformation through modern engineering practices and AI-led innovation.

Job Overview

  • We are seeking an experienced Head of Engineering / Senior Product Manager to lead technology strategy, product engineering, platform modernization, and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • The role requires a strong technology leader who can manage large engineering teams, drive product delivery, build scalable architectures, and align technology initiatives with business objectives across multiple product lines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the technology roadmap aligned with business goals
  • Lead engineering teams across multiple products and platforms
  • Drive platform modernization using cloud-native and microservices architectures
  • Establish engineering best practices for quality, security, scalability, and performance
  • Manage the complete software development lifecycle from design to deployment
  • Implement Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices to improve delivery efficiency
  • Oversee development of eCommerce, procurement, ERP integration, and analytics platforms
  • Lead cloud infrastructure strategy across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
  • Ensure compliance with security and governance standards
  • Drive AI/ML, automation, and innovation initiatives across products
  • Collaborate with Product, Sales, Delivery, and Business teams to define technology priorities
  • Manage technology partners, vendors, and external stakeholders
  • Mentor engineering managers, architects, developers, QA, and DevOps teams
  • Establish technology KPIs and drive continuous improvement initiatives

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 12 20 years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership
  • Strong experience leading large-scale engineering and product teams
  • Proven experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Expertise in microservices, API-first architecture, and distributed systems
  • Experience managing enterprise applications, SaaS products, or digital platforms
  • Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, and software delivery processes
  • Experience with ERP integrations, procurement systems, or eCommerce platforms
  • Exposure to AI/ML, automation, and analytics-driven products

descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists

Most post-sale orgs are built to react - to churn signals, to escalations, to renewal deadlines. We're building JustCall's CS and Support function to get ahead of all three. As AI reshapes how revenue teams work, the customers who adopt it fastest win the most - and we need someone who can make that happen at scale.

We need a Head of Customer Experience who can sit across the table from a churning account, a skeptical CFO, or a product leader debating a roadmap - and walk out with a retention plan, a renewal committed, and a feedback loop that makes the product sharper. Someone who owns the full post-sale journey, holds hard GRR numbers, and treats every churn signal as a solvable problem.


What you'll actually do

  • Own the end-to-end post-sale customer journey - onboarding, adoption, health management, renewals, and support - and be accountable for GRR outcomes, not just activity.
  • Set retention targets, build operating models, and drive the segmented motions - SMB, mid-market, and complex accounts - that make them achievable.
  • Accelerate product adoption and AI feature activation within the first 90 days - not just platform onboarding, but measurable workflow transformation.
  • Lead Support against strict SLA, CSAT, and deflection goals - balancing human resolution with automated intervention at scale.
  • Build and maintain customer health systems - scoring models, churn signals, and escalation frameworks - that give the org early warning, not post-mortems.
  • Own headcount planning and org design for scale - structuring layers that create accountability without creating bureaucracy.
  • Hold the line with Sales on CS scope, build tight feedback loops with Product, RevOps, Marketing, and influence roadmap without owning it.
  • Drive a concrete point of view on what AI-enabled CS looks like at 1,000 accounts per CSM - and build toward it.


What we're looking for

  • 10+ years in customer-facing SaaS - CS, Account Management, Professional Services, or Support leadership - with at least 4 years managing managers.
  • Org scale experience - you've led a combined CS and Support team of 50–100 people, including frontline managers and team leads.
  • Hard GRR numbers - you can walk through the retention rate you owned, what moved it, what didn't, and what you'd do differently. Vague answers won't pass the bar here.
  • Segmented success motion - you've built different playbooks for SMB versus mid-market and know when tech-touch compounds value and when human intervention is non-negotiable.
  • Real AI adoption experience - either driving customers to adopt AI features at scale or transforming your team's operations with AI tooling. "We use ChatGPT for emails" doesn't count. Be specific about what changed and how you measured it.
  • Support org ownership - you've run or closely partnered with a support function and understand SLA design, tiering, escalation paths, and the balance between human and automated resolution.
  • Stakeholder fluency - you've held the line with Sales, built feedback loops with Product, and influenced the roadmap without owning it.


Edges that help

  • Domain background in communication platforms, CRMs, sales enablement, or contact centre software - you already speak your customers' language.
  • Experience building or scaling a tech-touch motion alongside high-touch - pooled CSMs, in-app nudges, automated health interventions.
  • A concrete point of view on how AI reshapes CS and Support beyond ticket deflection - what the CSM role looks like at 1,000 accounts per person.
  • Experience running renewal forecasting in partnership with RevOps or Finance, even if you didn't own the final number.
  • Familiarity with cohort-level churn analysis - and using that data to influence product and packaging decisions, not just report on them.


How we work

  • Outcomes over activity. We measure CS impact by GRR, AI adoption rates, SLA performance, and expansion revenue - not QBRs delivered.
  • High ownership from day one - you'll build the post-sale org, not inherit a finished one.
  • Fast cycles, real ambiguity, and the expectation that you bring both operational rigor and commercial instinct to every customer relationship.
  • Competitive pay tied to the retention outcomes you drive and the customer org you scale.


The bigger picture

JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product - used by 6,000+ businesses across 70+ countries to run their customer conversations. We're backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, have crossed $40M ARR, and are building toward $100M with the team, the product, and the infrastructure to get there.

If this is the role you've been waiting to find - let's talk.

SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to making hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

descriptionHtml:
Why Join Iris?

Are you ready to do the best work of your career at one of India’s Top 25 Best Workplaces in IT industry? Do you want to grow in an award-winning culture that truly values your talent and ambitions?

Join Iris Software — one of the fastest-growing IT services companies — where you own and shape your success story.

About Us

At Iris Software, our vision is to be our client’s most trusted technology partner, and the first choice for the industry’s top professionals to realize their full potential.

With over 4,300 associates across India, U.S.A, and Canada, we help our enterprise clients thrive with technology-enabled transformation across financial services, healthcare, transportation & logistics, and professional services.

Our work covers complex, mission-critical applications with the latest technologies, such as high-value complex Application & Product Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, Data & MLOps, Quality Engineering, and Business Automation.

Working with Us

At Iris, every role is more than a job — it’s a launchpad for growth.

Our Employee Value Proposition, “Build Your Future. Own Your Journey.” reflects our belief that people thrive when they have ownership of their career and the right opportunities to shape it.

We foster a culture where your potential is valued, your voice matters, and your work creates real impact. With cutting-edge projects, personalized career development, continuous learning and mentorship, we support you to grow and become your best — both personally and professionally.

Curious what it’s like to work at Iris? Head to this video for an inside look at the people, the passion, and the possibilities. Watch it here.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Strategy and Vision
  • Define and communicate the long-term vision and strategic roadmap for the core platform, encompassing infrastructure, shared services, common frameworks, developer tools, and security standards.
  • Act as the voice of the internal customer (other Product Teams, Engineering Teams, DevOps) to understand their dependency needs, pain points, and requirements for performance, scalability, and resilience.
  • Analyze market trends in platform technology (e.g., Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Observability) to ensure the platform remains modern, cost-effective, and competitive.
  • Define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for the platform, focusing on technical metrics like developer velocity, system reliability, security compliance, and cost efficiency.
  • Platform Development and Prioritization
  • Manage, groom, and prioritize the Platform Backlog, translating architectural epics, technical debt, and cross-cutting requirements into clear user stories with defined acceptance criteria.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, reviews) for the Platform Engineering team.
  • Balance conflicting priorities between immediate feature delivery support, critical security patches, and necessary long-term architectural investment (technical debt repayment).
  • Collaborate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Leads to ensure all platform development aligns with the overall Enterprise Architecture.
  • Accept or reject completed stories based on the Definition of Done, ensuring high standards for code quality, documentation, security, and operational readiness.
  • Stakeholder Management and Communication
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Platform Engineering team and the consuming Product Teams.
  • Manage communication and dependencies across multiple technical teams, clearly articulating platform capabilities, upcoming changes, and migration paths.
  • Create and maintain high-quality documentation (APIs, integration guides, service catalog) to accelerate adoption and reduce cognitive load for dependent teams.
  • Conduct internal demos and training to socialize new platform features and drive adoption across the organization.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience
  • 5+ years of experience in software development, engineering management, or product ownership in a technical domain.
  • 3+ years specifically serving as a Product Owner or Technical Lead for a platform, infrastructure, or shared services team.
  • Proven experience working with complex, distributed systems (Microservices, APIs) and Cloud-Native technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Technical Fluency
  • Strong understanding of modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and service meshes.
  • Working knowledge of core platform components such as API Gateways, identity management (OAuth/OpenID), monitoring (Observability), and container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker).
  • Ability to read, understand, and discuss technical designs, architectural diagrams, and trade-offs with Principal Engineers.

Mandatory Competencies

BA - Business Analyst - Requirement Gathering

BA - Business Analyst - GAP Analysis

BA - Business Analyst - SWOT Analysis

BA - SQL

BA - Business Analyst - Business Process Modelling

Beh - Communication and collaboration

Perks And Benefits For Irisians

Iris provides world-class benefits for a personalized employee experience. These benefits are designed to support financial, health and well-being needs of Irisians for a holistic professional and personal growth. Click here to view the benefits.

descriptionHtml:
Why Join Iris?

Are you ready to do the best work of your career at one of India’s Top 25 Best Workplaces in IT industry? Do you want to grow in an award-winning culture that truly values your talent and ambitions?

Join Iris Software — one of the fastest-growing IT services companies — where you own and shape your success story.

About Us

At Iris Software, our vision is to be our client’s most trusted technology partner, and the first choice for the industry’s top professionals to realize their full potential.

With over 4,300 associates across India, U.S.A, and Canada, we help our enterprise clients thrive with technology-enabled transformation across financial services, healthcare, transportation & logistics, and professional services.

Our work covers complex, mission-critical applications with the latest technologies, such as high-value complex Application & Product Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, Data & MLOps, Quality Engineering, and Business Automation.

Working with Us

At Iris, every role is more than a job — it’s a launchpad for growth.

Our Employee Value Proposition, “Build Your Future. Own Your Journey.” reflects our belief that people thrive when they have ownership of their career and the right opportunities to shape it.

We foster a culture where your potential is valued, your voice matters, and your work creates real impact. With cutting-edge projects, personalized career development, continuous learning and mentorship, we support you to grow and become your best — both personally and professionally.

Curious what it’s like to work at Iris? Head to this video for an inside look at the people, the passion, and the possibilities. Watch it here.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Strategy and Vision
  • Define and communicate the long-term vision and strategic roadmap for the core platform, encompassing infrastructure, shared services, common frameworks, developer tools, and security standards.
  • Act as the voice of the internal customer (other Product Teams, Engineering Teams, DevOps) to understand their dependency needs, pain points, and requirements for performance, scalability, and resilience.
  • Analyze market trends in platform technology (e.g., Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Observability) to ensure the platform remains modern, cost-effective, and competitive.
  • Define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for the platform, focusing on technical metrics like developer velocity, system reliability, security compliance, and cost efficiency.
  • Platform Development and Prioritization
  • Manage, groom, and prioritize the Platform Backlog, translating architectural epics, technical debt, and cross-cutting requirements into clear user stories with defined acceptance criteria.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, reviews) for the Platform Engineering team.
  • Balance conflicting priorities between immediate feature delivery support, critical security patches, and necessary long-term architectural investment (technical debt repayment).
  • Collaborate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Leads to ensure all platform development aligns with the overall Enterprise Architecture.
  • Accept or reject completed stories based on the Definition of Done, ensuring high standards for code quality, documentation, security, and operational readiness.
  • Stakeholder Management and Communication
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Platform Engineering team and the consuming Product Teams.
  • Manage communication and dependencies across multiple technical teams, clearly articulating platform capabilities, upcoming changes, and migration paths.
  • Create and maintain high-quality documentation (APIs, integration guides, service catalog) to accelerate adoption and reduce cognitive load for dependent teams.
  • Conduct internal demos and training to socialize new platform features and drive adoption across the organization.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience
  • 5+ years of experience in software development, engineering management, or product ownership in a technical domain.
  • 3+ years specifically serving as a Product Owner or Technical Lead for a platform, infrastructure, or shared services team.
  • Proven experience working with complex, distributed systems (Microservices, APIs) and Cloud-Native technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Technical Fluency
  • Strong understanding of modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and service meshes.
  • Working knowledge of core platform components such as API Gateways, identity management (OAuth/OpenID), monitoring (Observability), and container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker).
  • Ability to read, understand, and discuss technical designs, architectural diagrams, and trade-offs with Principal Engineers.

Mandatory Competencies

BA - Business Analyst - Requirement Gathering

BA - Business Analyst - GAP Analysis

BA - Business Analyst - SWOT Analysis

BA - SQL

BA - Business Analyst - Business Process Modelling

Beh - Communication and collaboration

descriptionHtml:
About Our Client

Our client is a rapidly growing, Series B-funded Conversational AI company that is redefining how businesses engage with customers through AI-powered interactions. The company serves leading enterprises globally and is building category-defining products at the intersection of AI, automation, and customer experience.


Role Overview

Our client is seeking a Head of Growth Marketing to lead customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and revenue growth across key markets. This leader will be responsible for building and scaling a world-class growth engine spanning demand generation, performance marketing, product marketing, lifecycle marketing, and growth experimentation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the overall growth marketing strategy and execution across digital, content, events, partnerships, and account-based marketing channels.
  • Drive qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and revenue growth across enterprise and mid-market segments.
  • Develop and optimize performance marketing programs across paid, organic, and emerging AI-driven channels.
  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success teams to improve funnel conversion and accelerate growth.
  • Lead product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market initiatives for new products and market expansions.
  • Establish a data-driven growth culture through experimentation, analytics, attribution, and conversion optimization.
  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing growth marketing team.


Ideal Candidate

  • 8–15 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, product marketing, or related GTM functions within high-growth technology companies.
  • Demonstrated success driving pipeline and revenue growth for B2B SaaS, AI, cloud, or enterprise software businesses.
  • Strong understanding of modern growth channels, marketing automation platforms, CRM systems, and analytics tools.
  • Experience partnering closely with sales organizations in enterprise go-to-market environments.
  • Analytical, execution-oriented, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-growth settings.

descriptionHtml:
Role Overview:


The Head of Merchandising will be responsible for defining and driving the overall merchandising strategy for the jewellery business across verticals Gold, Diamonds, Silver and Platinum. The person will be accountable for assortment planning, category performance, pricing architecture, inventory productivity, and product lifecycle management. This role will work closely with design, sourcing, manufacturing, retail, e-commerce, marketing, and supply chain teams to ensure the right product mix, right stock levels, and right market positioning across channels.


Roles & Responsibilities:


Strategic Planning & Assortment Development:


Develop merchandising strategies to drive sales growth, profitability, and brand positioning.

Lead assortment planning across categories (gold, diamond, bridal, fashion), collections, price points, and store clusters.

Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor assortments to inform product selection and identify white-space opportunities.


Inventory & Commercial Performance:


Manage Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning, demand forecasting, and stock allocation across retail and e-commerce channels.

Optimize inventory levels for availability, productivity, and working capital efficiency.

Review product performance metrics (sell-through, margins, aging) and execute data-driven actions on replenishment, markdowns, SKU rationalization, and discontinuations.


Team & Vendor Management:


Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing merchandising team with clear KPIs.

Manage vendor relationships, negotiate pricing/terms, and ensure quality/compliance standards.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:


Partner with Design and Product Development to create commercially viable collections.

Coordinate with Marketing on campaign calendars, festive collections, bridal collections, launch sequencing, and promotional strategies.

Align with Sales, Retail Operations, and Visual Merchandising for optimal product presentation and execution.


Performance Monitoring & Reporting:


Prepare and present sales, inventory, and merchandising performance reports to senior leadership.

Continuously monitor KPIs and adjust strategies to maintain commercial excellence.


Category Focus:


Gold & Diamond: Evaluate purity/grading standards, forecast category demand, and manage exchanges/custom orders.

Bridal/Fashion: Identify emerging trends, rotate seasonal collections, and develop promotional bundles.

Daily/Occasion Wear: Balance price points across SKUs and monitor white-space opportunities through competitor analysis.


Education:


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Fashion Merchandising, Retail Management, or related field.

MBA or advanced degree preferred.


Professional Experience:


15+ years in merchandising or category management; 5 years in leadership roles.

Proven track record in jewellery/premium fashion accessories.

Experience managing assortment, pricing, and inventory management.


Skills Required:


Merchandising Strategy: Strong capability in category planning, range building, and lifecycle management.

Commercial Acumen: Ability to interpret sales, margins, sell-through, stock turn, and profitability metrics.

Market Insight: Good understanding of jewellery trends, customer preferences, competition, and pricing benchmarks.

Inventory Planning: Expertise in demand forecasting, replenishment, aging control, and SKU productivity.

Leadership: Experience leading teams and driving alignment across design, production, marketing, retail, and supply chain.

Systems Proficiency: Comfort with merchandising systems, ERP tools, and analytical platforms such as SAP or Power BI in larger retail setups.


Desired Candidate:


Strong experience in jewelry or luxury merchandising leadership roles.

Deep understanding of product categories such as gold, diamond, silver, platinum, bridal, daily wear, occasion wear, and premium collections.

Excellent analytical, planning, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

High commercial orientation with the ability to balance creativity and profitability.

description: Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Global Trade Solutions (GTS) vision is to ‘connect the world through trade’ by bringing the future of trade to our clients.The role will be responsible for structuring the distribution/ syndication of complex & innovative /bespoke deals across GTS product space with specific focus on Structured Trade Finance transactions such as Inventory Financing, Leasing and Non-bank Financial Institutions trade related financing. descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Business Descriptor

HSBC is the largest trade and receivable finance organisation in the world, offering a comprehensive range of traditional and structured trade solutions. Global Trade Solutions (GTS) vision is to ‘connect the world through trade’ by bringing the future of trade to our clients.

The role will be responsible for structuring the distribution/ syndication of complex & innovative /bespoke deals across GTS product space with specific focus on Structured Trade Finance transactions such as Inventory Financing, Leasing and Non-bank Financial Institutions trade related financing. The role holder will create, build and scale distribution with new solutions and structures.

The role holder will drive collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to share expertise and strategic guidance on the sector, while strenghening our client relationships and shaping our market expertise on trade finance in this sector.

The role will report to the Regional Head Trade Asset Distribution, Asia.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Sector Expertise/ Impact on the business

Structuring expertise

  • Excellent understanding of GTS Structured Trade Finance products and good understanding of other GTS Products and solutions, including import and export financing, Documentary Credits, Guarantees and Commodity Trade Finance.
  • Ability to structure bespoke and innovative solutions across sectors, products and geographies alongside embedding distribution. Understand the related legal clauses and documentation involved in structuring bespoke multi geography solutions
  • Ability to assess risk dynamics of clients and deals and build adequate risk mitigants to enable a sustainable and risk acceptable structure for the bank and the client
  • Ability to work with senior stakeholders at the clients end, understand their needs, structure bespoke solutions (multi-geography) and co-create innovative propositions to meet client requirements.
  • Thorough understanding of regulatory framework and expertise in implementing multi-geography, multi-product deals

Distribution Expertise

  • In depth knowledge and experience in Trade Asset Distribution from large scale deal origination and sell down. Good understanding of bilateral risk distribution techniques as well as insurance products.
  • Good knowledge of the process of transferring/selling trade risks including legal risks and clauses. Strong understanding of how the secondary market operates and awareness of investor trends and dynamics.
  • Excellent knowledge of how distribution (mitigation or transfer) can help to reduce or eliminate risks in order to achieve for example credit, cross border or balance sheet relief
  • Work closely with Frontline sales managers and grow business volumes and drive balance sheet velocity
  • Professionally and technically solid, must be able to easily interact with sophisticated stakeholders such as Financial Institution investors as well as clients to promote value of distribution
  • Actively manage the risk distribution and risk participation pipeline and facilitate the structuring of complex trade transactions on an end-to-end basis; this covers from deal origination, namely, client needs and solution finding, to coordinating and supervising proper execution by Operations
  • Oversee the Trade Asset Distribution (TAD) in India, covering participation in and distribution of trade risks and Indian trade assets.
  • Represent TAD team in external market bodies/events/conferences to develop market intelligence and establish strong market presence

Sector expertise

  • Be in the inhouse sector expert on GTS global priority sectors, supply chains, regulatory environments and working capital needs
  • Understand current economic trends and impact on HSBC to identify key levers to capitalise on opportunities or minimise downside exposure
  • Drive industry leading best practices across the GTS and Bank network through partnership with internal teams as well as external industry experts, to generate insights and solutions
  • Closely follow the development of ESG solutions for trade finance to embed them in solutions offered to external investors
  • Up skill sales force to drive strategic client conversations via regular teach in sessions, improving client understanding
  • Actively promote TAD value proposition with internal stakeholders through regular calls, sessions, and e-mail communication to raise awareness
  • Customers/ Stakeholders (Internal/External)
  • Work closely with senior client contacts to understand their needs and structure bespoke solutions to match their ask.
  • Support Front Line Sales Managers in pitching and structuring GTS transactions in Asia primarily for Structured Trade Finance transactions (however not limited to this product suite)
  • Coordinate multi-disciplinary teams and stakeholders in order to structure the distribution element of multi-currencies and cross border transactions
  • Manage investor relationships (Financial Institutions, Non-Bank Financial Institutions, and private funds) including identifying and developing new relationships with potential investors in the secondary market
  • Develop the network of key stakeholders, including Global Trade Solution Sales Managers, CIB Relationship Managers, Country Heads of Trade, Regional Head of Product Management, Financial Institutions Group Relationship Managers and Sales Managers, GTS Services, and other key risk stewards
  • Management of Risk (Operational Risk / FIM requirements)
  • The jobholder will ensure the fair treatment of our customers is at the heart of everything we do, both personally and as an organisation.
  • This will be achieved by consistently displaying the behaviours that form part of the HSBC Values and culture and adhering to HSBC risk policies and procedures, including notification and escalation of any concerns and taking required action in relation to points raised by audit and/or external regulators.
  • The jobholder will also continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of modern technology.
  • The job holder demonstrates adherence of Regulatory & Compliance matters and maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with GTS FIM.
  • Observation of Internal Controls (Compliance Policy / FIM requirements)

Maintain and observe HSBC internal control standards, implement, and observe Group Compliance Policy, including the timely implementation of recommendations made by internal/external auditors and external regulators. Foster a compliance culture and implement Group Compliance Policy by managing compliance risk in liaison with the Head of Group Compliance, Regional Compliance Officer, or Local Compliance Officer, ensuring adequate compliance resources are in place and training is provided, and optimising relations with regulators.

Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience

The base location of this role is India.

Qualifications & Skill Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, related field, or equivalent experience
  • Good knowledge of Trade Products and Services such as Letters of Credit, Guarantees, Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Solutions, Structured Finance
  • Good knowledge of Receivables Finance trade structures and acceptable underlying debt instruments
  • Past working experience in a correlated role, i.e. either GTS sales, structuring team and/or distribution, syndication or Portfolio Management
  • Experience in a Global bank structuring complex multi-jurisdictional transactions
  • Experience of working towards targets and willingness to be assessed against dedicated achievements
  • Robust understanding of the secondary market, established presence, credibility, and recognition in the market
  • Knowledge of Credit Risk Management, good to have experience in managing credit exposure
  • Business oriented, sales experienced, displays strong commercial awareness
  • Excellent organization skills, planning capacity and time management
  • Excellent communication skills: must be able to clearly articulate ideas and persuade with robust arguments
  • In depth knowledge of relevant regulations impacting the business, and the lending and credit approval process and Global Standards
  • Maintain macroeconomic awareness of secondary market trends, dynamics, investor activity, risk appetite, pricing analysis, country risk and ratings, liquidity positions

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
